message:

subject: Refactor password reset email flow to use Apprise
message:

Replaces legacy email service with Apprise-based notification system for password reset emails. Removes core/email.py, adds core/apprise.py, and updates backend logic to inject and use AppriseService. Moves email message construction to a dedicated module, updates environment variable usage, and improves error handling and frontend feedback for email sending failures.

subject: Update SMTP config and docs for email notifications
message:

subject: Add scheduled cleanup for expired password reset tokens
message:
Add scheduled cleanup for expired password reset tokens

Introduces a function to delete expired password reset tokens from the database and schedules it to run periodically. Also triggers token cleanup on application startup to ensure invalid tokens are removed promptly.

subject: Refactor password reset flow and improve i18n support
message:

Backend password reset logic was refactored for clearer error handling and documentation, removing boolean returns in favor of HTTP exceptions. Frontend now supports reset password translations for multiple languages, and the reset password view was simplified to remove token validity state and improve user feedback. Router logic was updated to allow unauthenticated access to the reset password route, and success/error messaging for password reset was improved.

subject: Refactor signup migration and update user model comments
message:
Refactor signup migration and update user model comments

Replaces the previous signup migration with a new, more robust Alembic migration for v0.15.0, adding signup and verification columns to server_settings and users tables. Also updates comments in the User model for clarity regarding boolean fields.

subject: Refactor ServerSettings schema with enums and stricter types
message:
Refactor ServerSettings schema with enums and stricter types

Replaced integer fields for units and currency with IntEnum-based types for better type safety and clarity. Added detailed docstrings and stricter validation using StrictInt and Pydantic's ConfigDict. Enhanced model configuration to forbid extra fields and validate assignments.

subject: Refactor is_active to active boolean for users, gear, and components
message:
Refactor is_active to active boolean for users, gear, and components

Replaces the 'is_active' integer field with a boolean 'active' field in users, gear, and gear_components models, schemas, and related backend/frontend logic. Updates migration scripts, API, and UI components to use the new field, improving consistency and clarity for active status handling.

subject: Refactor access type usage and add schema docstrings
message:
Refactor access type usage and add schema docstrings

Updated session access type checks to use UserAccessType enum instead of constants. Added detailed docstrings to user schema enums and password validation for improved code clarity and maintainability. Also refactored constants.py for better readability.

subject: Implement email verification for user signup
message:
Implement email verification for user signup

Added secure token generation and hashing for email verification, refactored backend signup flow to store token hashes, and send confirmation emails using a new email message utility. Updated frontend server settings UI to allow configuration of signup, admin approval, and email confirmation requirements. Adjusted related backend and frontend logic and translations for improved clarity and consistency.

subject: Improve user input validation and UI for signup and user modals
message:
Improve user input validation and UI for signup and user modals

Enhanced frontend user input validation for email, password, and height fields in SignUpView and UsersAddEditUserModalComponent. Updated UI to display units more clearly and provide real-time validation feedback. Refactored SignUpView to use individual refs instead of a reactive form object, removed beta tags from login view, and added enum value serialization to UserBase schema in backend.

subject: Refactor signup flow and unify gender translations
message:
Refactor signup flow and unify gender translations

Updated backend and frontend to use new sign-up endpoints ('sign-up/request' and 'sign-up/confirm') and refactored related service calls. Moved gender option translations to generalItems for consistency and removed duplicates from user modal i18n files. Enhanced SignUpView with additional fields (preferred language, first day of week, currency), improved form logic, and streamlined height input handling. Moved user goals calculation logic from crud.py to utils.py for better separation of concerns.

subject: Improve sign-up view and server settings handling
message:
Improve sign-up view and server settings handling

Added new sign-up related settings to serverSettingsStore and updated SignUpView.vue to use direct property access for server settings. Also added a success message to the i18n signupView.json and improved feedback on successful sign-up.

subject: Refactor server settings schemas and improve frontend loading
message:
Refactor server settings schemas and improve frontend loading

Backend server settings schemas were refactored to separate edit, read, and public views, and API endpoints were updated to use these new schemas. Server settings scopes were adjusted for admin and regular users. On the frontend, SettingsServerSettingsZone.vue now loads server settings asynchronously and displays a loading indicator, and serverSettingsStore resets sensitive fields on logout. Minor i18n and service improvements were made for error handling and API consistency.

subject: Add sign-up token system for email verification
message:
Add sign-up token system for email verification

Introduces a new sign_up_tokens module with models, schema, CRUD, and utility functions to support email verification via sign-up tokens. Updates the user sign-up flow to use sign-up tokens instead of storing email verification tokens in the users table. Adds related database migration, relationships, and email messaging logic. Removes obsolete email_verification_token field and logic from user creation.

subject: Handle MFA verification error in fetchWithRetry
message:
Handle MFA verification error in fetchWithRetry

Adds a specific check for 'Invalid MFA code' errors when calling the 'mfa/verify' endpoint, ensuring such errors are thrown immediately instead of triggering a token refresh.

subject: Add MFA authentication flow documentation
message:
Add MFA authentication flow documentation

Documents the multi-factor authentication (MFA) login flow, including request/response formats for web and mobile clients, error handling, and important notes about session management. This addition clarifies the two-step authentication process for users with MFA enabled.

subject: Refactor session management and password handling
message:
Refactor session management and password handling

Introduces a new password hasher utility with strong password policy enforcement and replaces legacy password complexity checks. Refactors session CRUD operations for improved error handling and type safety. Adds a token manager for JWT creation/validation. Updates session schemas with stricter validation and documentation. Refactors session router endpoints for clarity and consistent client handling. Removes legacy password complexity and bcrypt logic from security module. Improves device info parsing and session object creation in utils. These changes enhance security, maintainability, and code clarity.

subject: Fixing import checking to filter out blank names or names that would be modified to be blank.
message: Fixing import checking to filter out blank names or names that would be modified to be blank.

subject: Improve gear nickname parsing and update Strava import docs
message:
Improve gear nickname parsing and update Strava import docs

Enhanced gear nickname parsing by stripping whitespace after decoding in gear CRUD functions. Updated documentation for Strava bulk import to clarify import steps, note removal of '+' and whitespace, and correct development timelines for shoes and activity metadata imports.

subject: Update dependencies
message:
Update dependencies

Upgraded several dependencies in package.json and package-lock.json, including jsdom, cssstyle, eslint, and rollup, to their latest versions for improved compatibility and security.

subject: Refactor password hasher injection and usage
message:
Refactor password hasher injection and usage

Centralizes password hasher initialization and injects it via FastAPI dependency in session, user, and sign-up token routers. Updates user CRUD and utility functions to accept the password hasher as an argument, improving testability and future extensibility. Removes legacy hasher initialization from session.security and ensures all password operations use the injected hasher instance.

subject: Add migration to lowercase user nicknames
message:
Add migration to lowercase user nicknames

Introduces migration 6 to convert all user nicknames to lowercase. Updates Alembic migration to register and unregister migration 6 in the migrations table. Integrates migration 6 execution into the migration utility.

subject: Update migration to lowercase usernames instead of nicknames
message:
Update migration to lowercase usernames instead of nicknames

Changed migration logic and description to lowercase the 'username' field for users instead of 'nickname'. This ensures consistency with the intended schema update.

subject: Validate user data with schema in migration 6
message:
Validate user data with schema in migration 6

Introduces validation of user data using the UserRead schema before editing users in migration_6.py. This ensures data consistency and leverages Pydantic validation during the migration process.

message: Updating gear import and duplicate checking routines for error found in issue 361 and discussion in #285.

subject: Refactor token handling to use TokenManager class
message:
Refactor token handling to use TokenManager class

Moved JWT token creation, decoding, and validation logic from session.security to a dedicated TokenManager class in session.token_manager. Updated dependencies and function signatures in router, security, and utils modules to use TokenManager for all token operations, improving modularity and maintainability.

subject: Normalize username and email to lowercase on user forms
message:
Normalize username and email to lowercase on user forms

User creation and editing now convert usernames and emails to lowercase in frontend forms and backend logic to ensure consistency and prevent duplicate accounts with case variations. Birthdate is also converted to ISO format during migration for data uniformity.

subject: Refactor scope handling and update session token logic
message:
Refactor scope handling and update session token logic

Renames all 'scopes' references to 'scope' throughout the backend, including router dependencies, session security, and token manager logic. Updates session constants to use singular 'scope' variables and dictionary names. Adds support for longer refresh tokens in the database and Alembic migration. Refactors token manager to handle scope extraction and token creation with new logic. Updates CORS and config to use ENDURAIN_HOST from core_config. This improves consistency and prepares for more granular scope management.

subject: Refactor security scope checks to use check_scopes
message:
Refactor security scope checks to use check_scopes

Replaces all usage of session_security.check_scope with session_security.check_scopes across routers and dependencies, updating parameter names from _check_scope to _check_scopes for consistency. Also renames TokenManager.get_token_scopes to get_token_scope and updates related docstrings and claim validation logic. This improves clarity and standardizes scope checking throughout the backend.

subject: Hash and shorten refresh tokens in sessions
message:
Hash and shorten refresh tokens in sessions

Refresh tokens are now hashed before being stored and their column length is reduced to 255 characters. All session-related CRUD, models, and utilities have been updated to use hashed refresh tokens. The migration deletes existing sessions to ensure compatibility. Token validation error handling is improved, and device type handling is now more explicit using an enum.

subject: Add detailed docstrings to session models and security
message:
Add detailed docstrings to session models and security

Comprehensive docstrings were added to the UsersSessions model and all major functions in session/security.py to improve code readability and maintainability. Variable names were also updated for clarity (e.g., noncookie_token to non_cookie_token).

subject: Refactor session token handling and router dependencies
message:
Refactor session token handling and router dependencies

Replaces get_user_id_from_access_token/refresh_token with get_sub_from_access_token/refresh_token and introduces get_sid_from_access_token/refresh_token for session ID extraction. Updates all router dependencies to use new methods, refactors session CRUD to use session ID instead of hashed refresh token, and improves token creation and validation logic for more robust session management. Also updates session_utils and token_manager to support new session ID claim and token structure.

subject: Update PWA icon path in Vite config
message:
Update PWA icon path in Vite config

Changed the 512x512 icon source path from /logo/logo-512.png to /logo/pwa-512x512.png in the Vite configuration for PWA manifest.

subject: Update session handling and error responses for login
message:
Update session handling and error responses for login

Backend endpoints now return session_id in a JSON object for web clients, improving consistency. Frontend logic updated to handle new session_id format and store it properly. Error handling for missing frontend resources improved with 404 responses. Minor cleanup in frontend login view and session management.

subject: Add docstrings and refactor session token creation
message:
Add docstrings and refactor session token creation

Added detailed docstrings to core and session router endpoints for improved API documentation. Refactored FastAPI app variable naming in main.py for clarity. Updated session token creation to accept an optional session_id, enabling token refresh to reuse the existing session ID.

subject: Refactor CSRF token handling in fetch utility
message:
Refactor CSRF token handling in fetch utility

Extracted CSRF token retrieval and header addition into helper functions for improved code clarity and reuse. Ensures CSRF token is re-added to request options after access token refresh.

subject: Updating with v0.15 code, updating docs to reflect new shoe import procedure.

subject: Add test infrastructure and improve docstrings
message:
Add test infrastructure and improve docstrings

Added pytest configuration, test dependencies, and initial test files for the backend. Introduced .env.test for test environment variables. Enhanced docstrings for database and session utility functions. Updated .gitignore for test artifacts.

subject: Add comprehensive tests for session and MFA endpoints
message:
Add comprehensive tests for session and MFA endpoints

Expanded the test suite for session-related endpoints, including MFA verification, token refresh, logout, and session management. Added mock security dependency overrides in conftest.py to facilitate authenticated endpoint testing. The new tests cover success and error scenarios for web and mobile clients, including edge cases for invalid tokens, inactive users, and invalid client types.

subject: Update tests to use new FastAPI client cookies API
message:
Update tests to use new FastAPI client cookies API

Refactor session and logout endpoint tests to set cookies using the FastAPI client's cookies API instead of passing cookies in the request. This aligns the tests with the updated FastAPI test client interface and ensures compatibility with future versions.

subject: Drop MariaDB support and update dependencies
message:
Drop MariaDB support and update dependencies

Removed MariaDB support from documentation and backend code, standardizing on PostgreSQL as the only supported database. Updated backend dependencies in poetry.lock and pyproject.toml, removing mysqlclient and updating several packages. Documentation and example files were updated to reflect the database change.

subject: Refactor login and modal components, add validation utils
message:
Refactor login and modal components, add validation utils

Refactored LoginView.vue to use TypeScript, improved structure, and added type-safe error handling and notification logic. Introduced a reusable Bootstrap modal composable (useBootstrapModal.ts), centralized HTTP status constants (httpConstants.ts), and added validation utilities (validationUtils.ts). Updated ModalComponentEmailInput.vue for better type safety, real-time validation, and input sanitization. Extended type definitions in types/index.ts and made minor code style improvements in serviceUtils.js.

subject: Centralize password validation logic in utility module
message:
Centralize password validation logic in utility module

Refactored password validation across components to use new isValidPassword and passwordsMatch utilities from validationUtils.ts. This ensures consistent password requirements and reduces code duplication. Updated related components and views to import and use these utilities, and enhanced validationUtils.ts with configurable password validation functions and documentation.

subject: Refactor password reset to use injected password hasher
message:
Refactor password reset to use injected password hasher

Updated backend password reset logic to inject and use a PasswordHasher instance instead of relying on session.security. Adjusted function signatures and calls accordingly. Improved frontend ResetPasswordView with enhanced UI, accessibility, and code documentation, including better validation, error handling, and layout.

subject: Revise and expand Copilot instructions for Endurain
message:
Revise and expand Copilot instructions for Endurain

Major update to .github/copilot-instructions.md: adds explicit AI/Copilot behavior guidelines, clarifies frontend/backend/Docker workflows, introduces detailed code quality and accessibility standards, and provides a comprehensive code review checklist. The document now includes a 10-section Vue component structure, centralized utility usage, and updated architecture and refactoring priorities to guide consistent, high-quality development.

subject: Add SSO identity provider support (backend & frontend)
message:
Add SSO identity provider support (backend & frontend)

Introduces full support for external identity providers (SSO) including database migrations, backend CRUD/service/routes, and frontend management UI. Adds new models, schemas, and API endpoints for configuring and managing identity providers, as well as user-to-provider linking. Updates server settings to support SSO options and enhances the login flow to allow SSO authentication. Includes new frontend components for managing identity providers, SSO login icons, and related i18n resources.

subject: Remove button color and text from identity providers
message:
Remove button color and text from identity providers

Eliminates the 'button_color' and 'button_text' fields from the identity provider models, schemas, migration, and related backend/frontend logic. This simplifies the identity provider configuration and API, removing custom button appearance options.

subject: Remove FontAwesome icon fallback for identity providers
message:
Remove FontAwesome icon fallback for identity providers

Simplifies the provider logo rendering by only displaying custom logos and removing the FontAwesome icon fallback logic and related code. Cleans up unused icon mapping and helper functions.

subject: Refactor identity providers zone with list component
message:
Refactor identity providers zone with list component

Refactored the SettingsIdentityProvidersZone to use a new IdentityProviderListComponent for displaying and managing identity providers. Moved provider-specific logic and actions (edit, delete, enable/disable, details) into the new component, improving modularity and maintainability. Updated related modals and event handling, and enhanced i18n keys and provider details display. Also fixed minor issues in user list and sidebar components.

subject: Refactor identity provider templates to be API-driven
message:
Refactor identity provider templates to be API-driven

Identity provider templates are now fetched from the backend API instead of being hardcoded in the frontend. Updated components to accept and use the templates prop, improved accessibility and form structure, and added the IdentityProviderTemplate type. Adjusted the API endpoint in the service and removed the static template definitions from the modal component.

subject: Centralize IdentityProvider interface in types
message:
Centralize IdentityProvider interface in types

Moved the IdentityProvider interface definition from individual components to the shared types file and updated imports accordingly. This change improves type consistency and maintainability across the codebase.

subject: Enhance OIDC provider support and frontend chunking
message:
Enhance OIDC provider support and frontend chunking

Improves OIDC provider handling in the backend by adding detailed error handling, HTTP client reuse, and new templates for Microsoft and Google providers. Updates frontend to use environment-based URLs for identity provider login, refines i18n text, and configures Vite to optimize chunk splitting and API proxying for better performance and development experience.

subject: Add session middleware for OAuth and refactor IdP service
message:
Add session middleware for OAuth and refactor IdP service

Introduces Starlette's SessionMiddleware to enable proper session management for OAuth state and nonce in the FastAPI app. Refactors IdentityProviderService to use request.session for OAuth state, nonce, and IdP ID storage, and improves docstrings and code clarity. Also updates charset-normalizer dependency in poetry.lock and pyproject.toml.

subject: Add Galician language support and improve SSO JWT decoding
message:
Add Galician language support and improve SSO JWT decoding

Introduces Galician ('gl') as a supported language across backend and frontend, including language switchers and user schema. Adds Galician translation files for all major UI components. Improves SSO userinfo retrieval by manually decoding JWT payloads without verification and sets the default language for new SSO users to US English. Updates language display logic in various Vue components to handle Galician.

subject: Refactor user default data creation and improve SSO flow
message:
Refactor user default data creation and improve SSO flow

Centralizes user default data creation into a single utility function and updates all user creation flows (standard, sign-up token, and SSO) to use it. Refactors SSO callback to pass session_id to the frontend for improved login handling. Cleans up SSO provider icon logic in the login view, adds loading state for SSO providers, and updates i18n strings for password visibility.

subject: Refactor SSO provider logo mapping and improve login view
message:
Refactor SSO provider logo mapping and improve login view

Moved PROVIDER_CUSTOM_LOGO_MAP to a new ssoConstants.ts for reuse and maintainability. Updated LoginView.vue and IdentityProviderListComponent.vue to import the constant. Added SSOProvider type to types/index.ts and improved LoginView.vue by using a computed serverSettings property, simplifying refs, and fixing SSO provider logo rendering.

subject: Refactor identity providers zone and improve i18n
message:
Refactor identity providers zone and improve i18n

Refactored SettingsIdentityProvidersZone.vue to use computed properties, centralized API error handling, and improved type inference. Updated event handler names for clarity and removed redundant click handler. Adjusted i18n keys for provider count messaging, removing 'labelNumberOfProviders' and adding 'labelNumberOfProviders1' and 'labelNumberOfProviders2' in both Galician and US English locales.

subject: Improve identity provider modal accessibility and layout
message:
Improve identity provider modal accessibility and layout

Updated IdentityProvidersAddEditModalComponent to generate unique IDs for form fields and associated labels, improving accessibility and supporting multiple modals. Adjusted SettingsUserGoals layout to better structure the add goal button and modal. Added enable/disable button translations to settingsIdentityProvidersZoneComponent.json.

subject: Refactor navbar components to TypeScript and improve structure
message:
Refactor navbar components to TypeScript and improve structure

Converted all Navbar-related Vue components to use TypeScript with explicit types and improved code structure. Added JSDoc comments, organized sections, and enhanced accessibility (ARIA labels) in the theme switcher. Improved language and notification switcher logic, including better type safety, lifecycle hooks, and real-time notification handling.

subject: Refactor Navbar structure and update bootstrap import
message:
Refactor Navbar structure and update bootstrap import

Moved the container-fluid div outside the nav element in NavbarComponent.vue for improved structure. Commented out the unused bootstrap.bundle.min.js import in main.js as it is not needed.

subject: Refactor template selection and slug handling in modal
message:
Refactor template selection and slug handling in modal

Removed unnecessary Ref typings for selectedTemplate and isSubmitting, simplified checks for selectedTemplate, and ensured provider slug is lowercased before submission. Added a console.log for debugging the templates prop.

subject: Refactor modals and IDP utils for improved accessibility
message:
Refactor modals and IDP utils for improved accessibility

Updated modal components to use template refs, improved ARIA labeling, and replaced checkboxes with select dropdowns for boolean options in the identity provider add/edit modal. Refactored useBootstrapModal composable to support both component and template refs. In backend, removed Google and Microsoft IDP templates and their filtering, and updated icon values for remaining templates.

subject: Decrypt client_id on identity provider retrieval
message:
Decrypt client_id on identity provider retrieval

Updated backend CRUD functions to decrypt the client_id field when retrieving identity provider records. Adjusted Pydantic schemas to clarify client_id handling and removed redundant client_id fields from create/update schemas.

message:

Introduces Galician (gl) as a supported language across backend and frontend. Updates language enums, language switchers, user profile, signup, and user modal components. Also updates documentation and version numbers to 0.15.1.

subject: Fix language flag icons for Catalan and Galician
message:
Fix language flag icons for Catalan and Galician

Corrects the flag icon classes for Catalan and Galician languages in the NavbarLanguageSwitcherComponent. Uses 'fi-es-ct' for Catalan and updates Galician to use 'fi-es-ga' instead of 'fi-es-gl'. Also fixes logic for displaying the correct flag based on the selected language.

subject: Improve identity provider error handling and SSO loading
message:
Improve identity provider error handling and SSO loading

Backend functions for retrieving identity providers now explicitly return None or an empty list when no results are found, and docstrings have been clarified. In the service layer, client_id decryption is commented out to avoid double decryption. On the frontend, server settings are now awaited before router setup, and SSO provider loading state is handled more robustly in the login view.

subject: Improve IDP deletion checks and modal cleanup
message:
Improve IDP deletion checks and modal cleanup

Backend: Prevent accidental persistence of decrypted identity provider data by expunging objects from the session, and ensure deletion is blocked if any user links exist using a new helper. Refactor user_identity_providers CRUD for clarity and add get_idp_has_user_links. Frontend: Enhance useBootstrapModal to clean up modal backdrops and body styles after hiding, and update serviceUtils to handle 204 No Content responses.

subject: Fix timezone usage in last_login update
message:
Fix timezone usage in last_login update

Replaces incorrect reference to datetime.timezone.utc with timezone.utc when updating the last_login field, ensuring proper UTC handling.

subject: Remove unused identity provider retrieval endpoints
message:
Remove unused identity provider retrieval endpoints

Deleted the backend API endpoint and frontend service method for retrieving a specific identity provider by ID, as well as related documentation. Also removed 'beta' tags from several UI components related to user goals and MFA, reflecting their stable status.

subject: Add support for storing IdP refresh tokens securely
message:
Add support for storing IdP refresh tokens securely

Implements secure storage of encrypted refresh tokens and related metadata for user-IdP links. Updates the database schema, Alembic migration, models, and CRUD functions to handle refresh tokens, access token expiry, and token update timestamps. Enhances the identity provider service to store tokens after authentication, improves error handling and logging, and ensures sensitive token data is never exposed via API schemas.

subject: Add IdP session refresh and token management helpers
message:
Add IdP session refresh and token management helpers

Introduces methods for refreshing a user's IdP session using stored refresh tokens, including secure decryption, error handling, and token storage. Adds helper methods to centralize client secret decryption, token endpoint resolution, OAuth client creation, and logic to determine when tokens should be refreshed. Refactors existing OAuth flows to use these helpers for improved maintainability and consistency.

subject: Add IdP token refresh and clearing on session events
message:
Add IdP token refresh and clearing on session events

Implements opportunistic refresh of identity provider (IdP) tokens during session refresh and clears all IdP refresh tokens on logout for enhanced security. Adds new utility functions to handle these operations, improving SSO experience and following OAuth2 best practices.

subject: Enforce IdP token max age and action-based refresh policy
message:
Enforce IdP token max age and action-based refresh policy

Introduces a maximum age policy for IdP refresh tokens and refactors token refresh logic to use explicit actions (SKIP, REFRESH, CLEAR) via a new TokenAction enum. The session and identity provider services now clear tokens that exceed the maximum age, refresh those close to expiry, and skip valid tokens, improving security and maintainability.

subject: Add IdP token revocation and enhance logout cleanup
message:
Add IdP token revocation and enhance logout cleanup

Implemented RFC 7009-compliant token revocation at the identity provider in IdentityProviderService. Updated clear_all_idp_tokens to optionally revoke tokens at the IdP before local clearing, controlled by a new revoke_at_idp parameter. Improved logging and error handling to ensure logout always succeeds, with revocation as a best-effort defense-in-depth measure.

subject: Add secure ID token verification using JWKS and joserfc
message:
Add secure ID token verification using JWKS and joserfc

Implements cryptographic verification of OIDC ID tokens using JWKS fetched from the identity provider and the joserfc library. Adds caching for JWKS, validates token claims (iss, aud, exp, nonce), and merges claims from the userinfo endpoint and ID token, replacing previous insecure manual JWT decoding. Improves security and OIDC compliance in the authentication flow.

subject: Add API rate limiting with slowapi middleware
message:
Add API rate limiting with slowapi middleware

Introduced a new rate limiting middleware using slowapi to protect key authentication and session endpoints from abuse. Added core.rate_limit module with predefined limits, integrated limiter and exception handler in main.py, and applied rate limits to OAuth and session login routes. Updated dependencies to include slowapi and limits. Improved docstrings in session/utils.py for clarity.

subject: Add timestamp and expiry validation to OAuth state
message:
Add timestamp and expiry validation to OAuth state

Enhances the OAuth state parameter by embedding a timestamp and encoding it as base64 JSON for improved CSRF protection. The callback now validates the state timestamp, rejecting states older than 10 minutes to prevent replay attacks.

subject: Refactor import/export services to use shared utils
message:
Refactor import/export services to use shared utils

Moved memory usage, timeout, and operation count logic from import_service.py and export_service.py into profile/utils.py for reuse and maintainability. Updated both services to use the new utility functions, removed duplicated code, and split file/media import logic in ImportService for clarity. Also adjusted default memory and timeout settings for consistency.

subject: Refactor import/export config to use shared base class
message:
Refactor import/export config to use shared base class

Introduced BasePerformanceConfig in utils.py to centralize common configuration logic for import and export services. Both ExportPerformanceConfig and ImportPerformanceConfig now inherit from this base class and use a unified memory tier detection and auto-configuration pattern, reducing code duplication and improving maintainability.

subject: Remove unused imports and add docstrings to MFA schema
message:
Remove unused imports and add docstrings to MFA schema

Eliminated unused 'psutil' imports from export_service.py and import_service.py. Added detailed docstrings to all classes and methods in schema.py for improved code documentation and clarity.

subject: Add comprehensive file security validation module
message:
Add comprehensive file security validation module

Introduces backend/app/core/file_security.py, providing advanced file validation for uploads including extension, MIME type, Unicode, and ZIP compression checks. Integrates security validation into profile image and data upload endpoints in router.py, refactors import/export service and exception imports, and updates profile/schema.py to support secure MFA secret storage. Dependency configuration updated in pyproject.toml.

subject: Refactor file security into modular package
message:
Refactor file security into modular package

Split file_security.py into a modular package with separate config, enums, exceptions, validators, inspectors, and utility modules. Added deep ZIP content inspection and threat categorization, improved configuration validation, and enhanced extensibility for file security checks.

subject: Remove legacy file_security.py and update related modules
message:
Remove legacy file_security.py and update related modules

Deleted backend/app/core/file_security.py and refactored related modules to remove dependencies on the legacy file security implementation. This streamlines the file security logic and ensures all validation is handled by the updated modular components.

subject: Refactor file security config and enums for clarity
message:
Refactor file security config and enums for clarity

Refactored file_security/config.py and enums.py to improve documentation, type annotations, and code clarity. Expanded exception imports and public API in __init__.py, removed deprecated utils.py, and updated configuration validation to use standard logging. Enhanced enum docstrings and structure for better maintainability.

subject: Optimize import service for large JSON files with streaming
message:
Optimize import service for large JSON files with streaming

Refactored the import_service to use streaming JSON parsing (via ijson) for large files, reducing memory usage during import operations. Updated method signatures and logic to process data in batches and load one data type at a time. Adjusted batch sizes in both import and export configs for all memory tiers. Added ijson as a dependency.

subject: Reverted ijson and in-memory streaming for activity import
message:
Reverted ijson and in-memory streaming for activity import

Reverted the use of ijson and streaming batch parsing for large activity component files with standard in-memory JSON loading. Updates the import logic to filter activity components per activity after loading all data, and removes ijson from dependencies.

subject: Refactor export/import services for batch size and streaming
message:
Refactor export/import services for batch size and streaming

Reduced default batch sizes in both ExportPerformanceConfig and ImportPerformanceConfig for improved memory efficiency. Refactored ExportService to stream data directly to the ZIP archive in batches, writing each data type progressively instead of collecting all data in memory first. Updated activity component collection to support chunked writing for large datasets, and removed excessive inline documentation for clarity and maintainability. ImportPerformanceConfig tier batch sizes were also adjusted to match the new export logic.

subject: Add and update docstrings for profile services and schema
message:
Add and update docstrings for profile services and schema

Added or revised concise, PEP 257-compliant docstrings for all public classes and methods in profile export/import services, router endpoints, exceptions, and MFA schema. Updated docstring formats to match new repository guidelines, clarified argument and return value descriptions, and removed extended explanations and examples. Also updated .github/copilot-instructions.md with new Python code style and docstring requirements.

subject: Refactor config and update MariaDB to Postgres migration docs
message:
Refactor config and update MariaDB to Postgres migration docs

Refactored backend/app/core/config.py to simplify and clarify docstrings and comments, improving readability and maintainability. Updated the MariaDB to Postgres migration guide to use Endurain's built-in export/import functionality instead of pgloader, providing a more user-friendly migration process. Removed obsolete pgloader migration files and transformation scripts.

subject: Refactor DB config, fix Strava import, update migration
message:
Refactor DB config, fix Strava import, update migration

Removed unused multi-DB support from database.py, fixed dependency in Strava shoe import endpoint, and corrected table/index names in Alembic migration for user identity providers. Also updated documentation and dependency lock files.

subject: Refactor auth and identity provider modules
message:
Refactor auth and identity provider modules

Moved authentication and identity provider logic from 'session' and 'identity_providers' modules into a new 'auth' package. Updated all relevant imports and references throughout the backend to use the new structure. Added language-specific coding standards files for Python and JavaScript/TypeScript in .github/instructions/. Minor bugfixes and code style improvements in Alembic migrations and routers. Profile export and import logic now also includes notifications and user idps info

subject: Refactor layout for add goal button and modal
message:
Refactor layout for add goal button and modal

Simplified the structure by removing unnecessary row and column wrappers around the add goal button and modal in SettingsUserGoals.vue. This change streamlines the component's layout and improves readability aligning with the rest of the code.

subject: Add browser redirect support for IdP linking
message:
Add browser redirect support for IdP linking

Introduces a new router and security dependencies to handle browser-based OAuth redirects for linking identity providers. The backend now separates browser redirect logic from API logic, with new functions for token extraction and validation in browser scenarios. The frontend updates the profile service to use a redirect-based approach for linking identity providers, improving compatibility with browser OAuth flows.

subject: Update IdP link redirect URL in public_router.py
message:
Update IdP link redirect URL in public_router.py

Changed the redirect URL for successful IdP linking to point to /settings with the security tab, instead of /settings/security. This aligns the redirect with the frontend route structure.

subject: Call cleanupBodyStyles after modal dispose
message:
Call cleanupBodyStyles after modal dispose

Ensures that body styles are cleaned up in the finally block after disposing the modal, preventing potential style leaks or side effects.

subject: Add birthdate validator to UserBase schema
message:
Add birthdate validator to UserBase schema

Introduced a field validator for the 'birthdate' field in the UserBase Pydantic model to ensure it is always stored as an ISO format string. This improves consistency when handling date values, supporting both date objects and pre-formatted strings.

subject: Refactor asset imports to use centralized constants
message:
Refactor asset imports to use centralized constants

Replaced hardcoded asset paths for avatars and integration logos with centralized constants in new files (gearAvatarConstants, integrationLogoConstants, userAvatarConstants). Updated components and views to use these constants, improving maintainability and consistency. Added TypeScript module declarations for image imports. Also refactored SSO provider logo imports to use ES module imports instead of string paths.

message:

subject: feat: Add user max heart rate override for HR zone calculations
message:
feat: Add user max heart rate override for HR zone calculations

Add optional max_heart_rate field to user profile to allow users to override
the age-based maximum heart rate calculation (220 - age).

Backend changes:
- Add max_heart_rate column to users table (nullable Integer)
- Update User model and schema to include max_heart_rate
- Create Alembic migration v0.16.0 to add the new column
- Modify heart rate zone calculation to use user's max_heart_rate if set,
  otherwise fallback to age-based formula

Frontend changes:
- Add max heart rate input field to user profile edit modal
- Display max heart rate in user profile view
- Add translations for US English and German locales
- Update UsersAddEditUserModalComponent to handle max_heart_rate

This allows users to provide a more accurate maximum heart rate based on
actual testing rather than relying solely on the age-based estimation,
resulting in more accurate heart rate zone calculations (zones 1-5) in
activity analysis.

subject: Update JSDoc and documentation standards for JS/TS
message:
Update JSDoc and documentation standards for JS/TS

Expanded and clarified documentation standards in javatsscript.instructions.md, including detailed JSDoc rules and examples for functions, classes, interfaces, and constants. This update aims to improve code clarity and maintainability by enforcing consistent and concise documentation practices.

subject: Fixed typo on README and docs index
message: Fixed typo on README and docs index

subject: Add Casdoor IdP support and improve credential handling
message:
Add Casdoor IdP support and improve credential handling

Introduces Casdoor as a supported identity provider, including icon and template. Refactors backend to decrypt client_id only when needed using a new helper, and moves decryption logic to Pydantic serializer for API responses. Updates database schema to use Text for refresh tokens. Adjusts frontend to display Casdoor in IdP lists and modals.

subject: Add Strava activity retrieval by date range
message:
Add Strava activity retrieval by date range

Updated backend and frontend to support retrieving Strava activities using a start and end date instead of days. Refactored API endpoints, utility functions, and UI components to handle date range selection and requests. Deprecated the previous days-based retrieval in favor of more flexible date range queries.

subject: Update FastAPI and Uvicorn, fix provider toggle logic
message:
Update FastAPI and Uvicorn, fix provider toggle logic

Upgraded FastAPI to 0.121.0 and Uvicorn to 0.38.0 in backend dependencies. Refactored IdentityProviderListComponent.vue to correctly update the provider's enabled status by modifying the provider object directly before sending the update request.

subject: Update icon placeholder options in identity provider modal
message:
Update icon placeholder options in identity provider modal

Revised the icon placeholder text to list 'authelia, authentik, casdoor, keycloak, or custom' instead of the previous options. This provides more accurate and relevant suggestions for SSO button icon names.

subject: Add redirect support to SSO login flow
message:
Add redirect support to SSO login flow

Implements optional frontend redirect path handling in both backend and frontend SSO login flows. Backend now accepts and propagates a 'redirect' query parameter through OAuth state, and frontend uses this to redirect users after successful SSO login. Also adds force local login messaging and handling.

subject: Refactor DB session management to use context managers
message:
Refactor DB session management to use context managers

Attempt fix for #393 - Replaces manual creation and closing of SQLAlchemy database sessions with context manager usage (with SessionLocal() as db) across multiple modules. This improves resource management and reduces boilerplate, ensuring sessions are properly closed even in case of exceptions. Also doubles DB connection pool size.

subject: Add Slovenian language support and bump version to 0.15.7
message:
Add Slovenian language support and bump version to 0.15.7

Introduces Slovenian (SL) as a supported language across backend and frontend, including language enum, language switchers, and i18n resources. Updates documentation to credit the contributor, and increments version numbers in backend and frontend to 0.15.7.

subject: Add Cardio training activity type support
message:
Add Cardio training activity type support

Introduces 'Cardio training' as a new activity type (ID 41) across backend and frontend. Updates activity mappings, enums, goal logic, UI components, and i18n files to support the new type. Also fixes goal list initialization in SettingsUserGoals.vue.

subject: Fix date format for Garmin body composition API call
message:
Fix date format for Garmin body composition API call

Changed the date format passed to api.get_body_composition from a datetime object to a string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format to match API requirements. Also updated .gitignore to exclude .garminconnect files.

subject: Add Slovenian flag to language switcher
message:
Add Slovenian flag to language switcher

Updated the NavbarLanguageSwitcherComponent to display the correct flag icon for Slovenian (sl) language, similar to existing custom flags for Catalan and Galician.

subject: Add Italian to Language enum and update docstring
message:
Add Italian to Language enum and update docstring

Introduces Italian ('it') to the Language enum and updates the class docstring to reflect the addition. Also reorders some entries for consistency.

subject: Improve activity filtering
message:
Improve activity filtering

Filters out None values from the activities list and returns None if the list is empty #395

subject: Improve activity chart rendering and remove downsampling label
message:
Improve activity chart rendering and remove downsampling label

Enhanced the ActivityStreamsLineChartComponent to remove data downsampling, add gradient fill, improve pace/cadence handling, and optimize chart rendering for better accuracy and performance. Also removed the downsampling label and related translation keys from ActivityMandAbovePillsComponent and i18n files. #340 #160

subject: Add zoom and pan to activity line chart
message:
Add zoom and pan to activity line chart

Integrated chartjs-plugin-zoom to enable zooming and panning on the ActivityStreamsLineChartComponent. Enhanced tooltip formatting for pace and other metrics for improved readability. Updated dependencies in package.json to include chartjs-plugin-zoom. #160 #340

subject: Add dynamic chart colors based on graph selection
message:
Add dynamic chart colors based on graph selection

Introduced the getGraphColors function to provide specific border and gradient colors for different graph types. Updated the chart rendering logic to use these dynamic colors, improving visual distinction between data types in the line chart. #340 #160

subject: Add average and max reference lines to activity chart
message:
Add average and max reference lines to activity chart

Enhanced the ActivityStreamsLineChartComponent to display average and maximum value reference lines on the chart, excluding null values. Added a custom crosshair plugin for improved tooltip interaction. Updated i18n strings to include labels for 'Average' and 'Maximum'. #160 #340

subject: Add custom grid styling to chart axes
message:
Add custom grid styling to chart axes

Configured grid lines, border drawing, and border width for both y and x axes in the ActivityStreamsLineChartComponent to improve chart readability and appearance. #160 #340

subject: Fix for inverted pace chart
message:
Fix for inverted pace chart

Fix for inverted pace chart #160 #340

subject: Add is_hidden field to activity edit schema and view
message:
Add is_hidden field to activity edit schema and view

Introduces the optional is_hidden field to the ActivityEdit Pydantic schema and updates the ActivityView to handle this field when editing activities #391

subject: Fix issue where user old photo might not be deleted from filesystem
message:
Fix issue where user old photo might not be deleted from filesystem

Fix issue where user old photo might not be deleted from filesystem

subject: Improve map markers and UI formatting
message:
Improve map markers and UI formatting

Enhanced ActivityMapComponent to use custom styled start and end markers with improved polyline appearance.

subject: Bump dependencies + added missing variable default declaration
message: Bump dependencies + added missing variable default declaration

subject: Add activity name support to file parsing functions
message:
Add activity name support to file parsing functions

Introduces an optional activity_name parameter to GPX, TCX, and FIT file parsing utilities, allowing the activity name to be set from external sources (such as Garmin Connect). Updates related function signatures and usages throughout the codebase to propagate this parameter. Also adds windsurf to ActivityDistances schema and improves type annotations and error handling in activity utilities.

subject: Improve activity type handling and gear updates
message:
Improve activity type handling and gear updates

Refactored gear selection logic into a reusable function and ensured gear list updates when activity type changes. Fixed cadence calculation for running in the line chart, corrected prop type for gearsByType, and removed unnecessary assignment in activity deletion. #415 and #418

subject: Add kayaking activity type (42) across app
message:
Add kayaking activity type (42) across app

Introduces kayaking as a new activity type (ID 42) in backend and frontend. Updates activity mappings, i18n labels, UI components, and search logic to support kayaking alongside rowing where appropriate. #411

subject: Add Sailing activity type support across app
message:
Add Sailing activity type support across app

Introduces Sailing (type 43) as a supported activity throughout the backend and frontend. Updates activity mappings, i18n files, UI dropdowns, and utility functions to include Sailing. Adjusts search and filtering logic to handle the new activity type and corrects some error message keys in SearchView. #411

subject: Add support for snow shoeing activity type (44)
message:
Add support for snow shoeing activity type (44)

Introduces 'Snow shoeing' as a new activity type (ID 44) across backend and frontend. Updates schema, activity mappings, goal calculations, developer documentation, i18n files, activity utilities, and UI components to support the new activity. Ensures snow shoeing is selectable, filterable, and properly displayed throughout the application. #411

subject: Add avg speed display for windsurf and sailing activities
message:
Add avg speed display for windsurf and sailing activities

Updated ActivitySummaryComponent to show average speed for windsurf and sailing activities. Extended formatAverageSpeed utility to support these activity types. #411

subject: Added Nginx Proxy Manager config example for Endurain
message: Added Nginx Proxy Manager config example for Endurain

subject: Add support for Inline Skating activity type
message:
Add support for Inline Skating activity type

Introduces 'Inline skating' as a new activity type (ID 45) across backend and frontend. Updates schemas, utility mappings, i18n files, UI components, and search functionality to handle inline skating activities. #411

subject: Add body composition fields to HealthData model
message:
Add body composition fields to HealthData model

Uncommented and integrated body composition fields (body_fat, body_water, bone_mass, muscle_mass, physique_rating, visceral_fat, metabolic_age) in the HealthData schema and processing logic. Updated backend to handle these fields and adjusted frontend to handle possible null BMI values. #401

subject: Add support for sailing and windsurf activities
message:
Add support for sailing and windsurf activities

Extended activity components and chart logic to handle sailing and windsurf activity types, including correct display of velocity and pace data. Updated conditional checks and imports to support these new activity types. Also improved ActivityView to show pills components when activity streams are present. #422

subject: Add collapsible section for activity hidden fields
message:
Add collapsible section for activity hidden fields

Grouped the activity hidden fields in the edit activity modal into a collapsible section for improved UI organization. Added a toggle button with icon state synced to the collapse state using Bootstrap events and Vue's reactivity. #423

subject: Localize label for activity hidden fields
message:
Localize label for activity hidden fields

Replaced the hardcoded 'Activity hidden fields' label in EditActivityModalComponent.vue with a localized string. Added the corresponding translation key to the i18n JSON file to support localization.

subject: Refactor health_data to health_weight module
message:
Refactor health_data to health_weight module

Migrates all health data functionality to a new health_weight module, including models, CRUD, utils, and API routes. Updates database schema and Alembic migration to use health_weight, removes the old health_data files, and updates all references throughout the backend and frontend. Adjusts API endpoints, i18n, and services to reflect the new health_weight naming and structure.

subject: Reverted wrong change made on Integrations logic
message: Reverted wrong change made on Integrations logic

subject: Add health steps tracking and UI integration
message:
Add health steps tracking and UI integration

Introduces backend models, CRUD, API routes, and Alembic migration for health steps tracking. Updates Garmin data processing to include daily steps, and adds frontend services, dashboard, and sidebar components for displaying and managing step data. Also refines health weight deletion, improves i18n, and updates related logic for better health data management.

subject: Add health steps tracking feature
message:
Add health steps tracking feature

Implemented full CRUD API endpoints for health steps in the backend, including create, update, and delete operations. Added new frontend components for managing, displaying, and visualizing health steps, including modals, bar chart, and list components. Updated dashboard and i18n files to support the new health steps feature. Also improved weight input UI and refactored some frontend scripts to use <script setup>. #404

subject: Unify health data models and migrations for steps and weight
message:
Unify health data models and migrations for steps and weight

Consolidates Alembic migrations for health_steps and health_weight into a single migration, removing redundant migration files. Refactors models and schemas to use a unified 'source' field (replacing garminconnect_body_composition_id) for both health_steps and health_weight, and updates related backend and frontend code to use this new field. Adds 'steps' to health_targets and updates enum usage for source fields. Frontend components now check 'source' for Garmin integration display.

subject: Add target lines and labels to health charts
message:
Add target lines and labels to health charts

Enhanced Health dashboard, steps, and weight components to display user target values with visual indicators and updated i18n labels. Steps and weight charts now show dashed target lines if targets are set, and card footers display units and icons for progress direction.

subject: Add weight target editing to health section
message:
Add weight target editing to health section

Introduces the ability for users to set and update their weight target. Adds a new modal for weight target input, updates the backend API with a PUT endpoint for health targets, and connects the frontend to this endpoint. Also includes related i18n updates and minor UI improvements for integration modals.

subject: Add steps target modal and update steps target logic
message:
Add steps target modal and update steps target logic

Introduced a new modal for setting the steps target in HealthStepsZone.vue, including UI changes to add a 'Steps target' button. Updated HealthView.vue to handle the new setStepsTarget event and update logic. Added related i18n strings for steps target actions and modal labels. Also set a default value for weight target in HealthWeightZone.vue.

subject: Add health sleep tracking support and models
message:
Add health sleep tracking support and models

Introduces backend support for health sleep data, including new models, CRUD operations, and schema in the health_sleep module. Adds Alembic migration for sleep data, updates Garmin health utilities, and integrates sleep data retrieval in aux_gc_getbcstats.py. Frontend sidebar and i18n files updated to reflect new health sleep features.

subject: Add health sleep tracking feature to backend and frontend
message:
Add health sleep tracking feature to backend and frontend

Introduces health sleep tracking with new backend API endpoints, database schema updates, and CRUD logic. Adds frontend components for displaying, listing, and visualizing sleep data, including bar and timeline charts. Updates i18n resources and refactors health steps and weight components for consistency. Adds chartjs-adapter-date-fns and date-fns dependencies for improved chart date handling.

subject: Add detailed sleep metrics and UI tabs for health sleep
message:
Add detailed sleep metrics and UI tabs for health sleep

Extended backend models, schema, and migration to support new sleep metrics such as HRV status, resting heart rate, skin temperature deviation, and sleep score breakdowns. Updated Garmin health utils to process and store these new fields. On the frontend, refactored HealthSleepListComponent to use a new HealthSleepListTabsComponent for tabbed sleep details, updated prop names for clarity, and added new i18n resources for the updated UI.

subject: Add sleep stress fields to HealthSleep model and schema
message:
Add sleep stress fields to HealthSleep model and schema

Introduces avg_sleep_stress and sleep_stress_score fields to the HealthSleep database model, schema, and migration. Updates health_utils to process and store these new sleep stress metrics from Garmin data.

subject: Inline health_sleep migration into main v0.16.0 migration
message:
Inline health_sleep migration into main v0.16.0 migration

Moved the creation and removal of the health_sleep table from a separate migration file into the main v0_16_0_migration.py. Deleted the now-redundant v0_16_0_migration_health_sleep.py migration file to consolidate schema changes.

subject: Add sleep target modal and improve sleep zone UI
message:
Add sleep target modal and improve sleep zone UI

Introduces a reusable ModalComponentHoursMinutesInput for setting sleep targets, integrates it into HealthSleepZone, and adds logic to update the user's sleep target. Enhances HealthSleepListTabsComponent with improved labels and i18n support, adds new utility functions for time conversion and health status mapping, and updates i18n files with relevant translations.

subject: Enhance sleep zone UI with improved labels and chart
message:
Enhance sleep zone UI with improved labels and chart

Refactored HealthSleepListTabsComponent to add summary and breakdown sections with clearer labels and structure. Updated HealthSleepTimelineChartComponent to use internationalized y-axis labels and improved legend, ensuring better localization and clarity. Added new i18n keys for sleep stages and related labels in both component and general items translation files. Minor UI improvements for consistency and readability.

subject: Ignore `time_active` for swimming activities without splits
message:
Ignore `time_active` for swimming activities without splits

When no `split_summary` is provided, treat `lap_swimming` activities active throughout the whole activity (thus, use the same calculation for pace as for other activity types).

subject: Enhance health dashboard and sleep details UI
message:
Enhance health dashboard and sleep details UI

Added new cards for sleep, resting heart rate, and skin temperature deviation to the health dashboard. Expanded HealthSleepListTabsComponent with detailed tabs for heart rate, SpO2, respiratory rate, and additional sleep metrics, including improved handling of missing data. Updated i18n files for new labels and units, and adjusted HealthSideBarComponent navigation order. Minor backend and script fixes for field naming and test data.

subject: Refactor weight list components and add details view
message:
Refactor weight list components and add details view

Refactored HealthWeightZone and related components to use 'userHealthWeight' prop instead of 'data', improving naming consistency. Enhanced HealthWeightListComponent with a collapsible details section showing BMI, body fat, body water, bone mass, and muscle mass. Updated i18n strings to support new details fields. Also improved code formatting and removed unnecessary console logs.

subject: Add detailed fields to weight add/edit modal
message:
Add detailed fields to weight add/edit modal

Expanded the HealthWeightAddEditModalComponent to include additional fields for BMI, body fat, body water, bone mass, and muscle mass, accessible via a collapsible section. Updated the i18n translations and ensured these new fields are handled in both add and edit flows, as well as reflected in the HealthView when weights are updated.

subject: Enhance health weight chart with more metrics
message:
Enhance health weight chart with more metrics

Expanded the HealthWeightLineChartComponent to display additional metrics (BMI, body fat, body water, bone mass, muscle mass) alongside weight, each with its own dataset and axis. Improved tooltip formatting and axis labeling. Also refactored and cleaned up UsersListComponent markup for readability, and improved type annotations in UsersListComponent. Backend health_utils.py now includes stricter validation for Garmin data fields to prevent errors from invalid or missing values.

subject: Improve sleep and weight data handling and chart display
message:
Improve sleep and weight data handling and chart display

Refactored backend Garmin sleep processing to robustly handle enum validation and avoid errors from unknown values. Updated frontend sleep list to conditionally render the timeline chart only if sleep stages exist. Reverted change to HealthWeightLineChartComponent.vue

subject: Add Resting Heart Rate (RHR) zone to health dashboard
message:
Add Resting Heart Rate (RHR) zone to health dashboard

Introduces new components for displaying and managing Resting Heart Rate (RHR) data, including a line chart and list view. Updates the sidebar navigation to include an RHR section, adjusts the HealthView layout to support the new zone, and adds relevant i18n strings. Refactors steps and sleep zone components for consistency and improves prop naming and usage.

subject: Refactor identity provider modals and icon handling
message:
Refactor identity provider modals and icon handling

Simplifies and condenses the markup in IdentityProviderListComponent.vue and IdentityProvidersAddEditModalComponent.vue for better readability and maintainability. Updates icon handling to support both predefined names and custom URLs, and clarifies icon help text in i18n to reflect this behavior.

subject: Add support for swimming lengths in FIT file parsing
message:
Add support for swimming lengths in FIT file parsing

Introduces parsing and handling of 'length' frames from FIT files, storing their data in a new 'lengths' array. Updates relevant functions to include and utilize 'lengths', particularly for more accurate swimming pace calculations based on active lengths.

subject: Fix swimming pace calculation for missing data
message:
Fix swimming pace calculation for missing data

Updates the pace calculation logic to handle cases where split_summary and lengths are missing for lap swimming activities, defaulting to the standard pace calculation.

subject: Add FIT file_id parsing and tracker info extraction
message:
Add FIT file_id parsing and tracker info extraction

Introduces parsing of the FIT file_id frame to extract manufacturer, product, serial number, and creation time. Updates activity object creation to include tracker manufacturer and model, and propagates file_id data through parsing and splitting functions for improved device metadata handling.

subject: Update config paths and docs for environment variables
message:
Update config paths and docs for environment variables

Changed DATA_DIR to use BACKEND_DIR for consistency in config.py and removed unused import in fit/utils.py. Added documentation for FRONTEND_DIR, BACKEND_DIR, DATA_DIR, and LOGS_DIR environment variables in advanced-started.md to clarify their usage.

subject: Update dependencies and remove unused peer fields
message:
Update dependencies and remove unused peer fields

Added max_heart_rate to authStore.js #390
Upgraded several backend Python packages (anyio, garminconnect, joserfc, psycopg, psycopg-binary, psycopg-pool, trove-classifiers) and frontend npm packages (@asamuzakjp/dom-selector, @csstools/css-syntax-patches-for-csstree, @eslint/eslintrc). Also removed unused 'peer' fields from multiple entries in package-lock.json for cleaner dependency management.

subject: Merge pull request #428 from h3083b8c95b5923f9/docs
message:
Merge pull request #428 from h3083b8c95b5923f9/docs

add bare-metal docs

subject: Refactor bulk import to use thread pool executor
message:
Refactor bulk import to use thread pool executor

Replaces FastAPI BackgroundTasks with a ThreadPoolExecutor for bulk activity import, queuing all files for processing in a single thread pool task. Adds process_all_files_sync to handle sequential file processing and database session management, improving scalability and resource usage. #399

subject: Reorder and add i18n paths in Crowdin config
message:
Reorder and add i18n paths in Crowdin config

Updated crowdin.yml to reorder translation path entries and add new paths for healthSleepZone, healthStepsZone, and settingsIdentityProvidersZone. This improves organization and ensures new translation files are included in Crowdin sync.

subject: Refactor health sleep tab labels for consistency
message:
Refactor health sleep tab labels for consistency

Replaced specific avg/max/min labels with generic ones in HealthSleepListTabsComponent and updated i18n keys accordingly. This simplifies label management and improves consistency across heart rate, SpO2, and respiratory rate sections.

subject: Update identity provider modal i18n for consistency
message:
Update identity provider modal i18n for consistency

Standardized capitalization and phrasing in identityProvidersAddEditModalComponent.json to improve consistency and readability of UI labels and help texts.

subject: Update goal modal and list titles for consistency
message:
Update goal modal and list titles for consistency

Changed capitalization in goal modal and list component i18n files to use sentence case for titles and labels, improving consistency across UI text.

subject: Update identity provider related UI text for consistency
message:
Update identity provider related UI text for consistency

Standardized capitalization and phrasing for identity provider related labels, modal titles, and button texts across settings components. This improves UI consistency and clarity for users managing identity providers and user authentication.

subject: Refactor health_weight API and add tests
message:
Refactor health_weight API and add tests

Refactored backend health_weight CRUD, models, router, schema, and utils for improved type safety, docstrings, and response structure. Added HealthWeightListResponse for paginated and total-count responses. Updated router endpoints to return total counts and records, and improved error handling. Added comprehensive unit tests for health_weight CRUD, models, and router. Updated frontend service and view to match new API response format.

subject: Refactor health_steps API and add tests
message:
Refactor health_steps API and add tests

Refactored backend health_steps CRUD, models, router, schema, and utils for improved type safety, docstrings, and response structure. Added HealthStepsListResponse for paginated and total-count responses. Updated router endpoints to return total counts and records, and improved error handling. Added comprehensive unit tests for health_steps CRUD, models, and router. Updated frontend service and view to match new API response format.

subject: Refactor health_targets API and add tests
message:
Refactor health_targets API and add tests

Refactored backend health_targets CRUD, models, router and schema for improved type safety, docstrings, and response structure. Added comprehensive unit tests for health_targets CRUD, models, and router. Added missing emit in HealthSleepZone.vue

subject: Refactor health_sleep API
message:
Refactor health_sleep API

Refactored backend health_sleep CRUD, models, router and schema for improved type safety, docstrings, and response structure. Added HealthSleepListResponse for paginated and total-count responses. Updated router endpoints to return total counts and records, and improved error handling. Added new route and CRUD function for deleting sleep and added frontend support for it. Simplified array update on update and delete actions for steps, weight and sleep on HealthView.vue alongisde i18n translations for new strings

subject: health_sleep API add tests and route for create and delete
message:
health_sleep API add tests and route for create and delete

Added comprehensive unit tests for health_sleep CRUD, models, and router. Added route for creating and deleting sleep entries

subject: Add HealthSleepAddEditModalComponent and refactor sleep zone
message:
Add HealthSleepAddEditModalComponent and refactor sleep zone

Introduces HealthSleepAddEditModalComponent for adding and editing sleep records. Refactors HealthSleepZone.vue to use the new modal, improves code formatting and readability across health and activity components, and updates event handling for sleep data management.

subject: Refactor sleep metrics to use integer types
message:
Refactor sleep metrics to use integer types

Changed heart rate, SpO2, respiration, and stress level fields from Decimal to Integer in backend models and schemas for consistency. Updated frontend modal to support unmeasurable sleep and removed nap time, aligning form fields and API payloads with backend changes. Adjusted data processing and validation logic to match new types and constraints.

subject: Add sleep scoring system and refactor health sleep fields
message:
Add sleep scoring system and refactor health sleep fields

Introduces a comprehensive sleep scoring module with detailed calculation logic and integration into health sleep creation and editing endpoints. Refactors HealthSleep model and schema to use integer types for heart rate, SpO2, respiration, and sleep stress fields. Updates related tests and documentation to reflect the new scoring system and data type changes.

subject: Add resting heart rate and skin temp deviation to sleep modal
message:
Add resting heart rate and skin temp deviation to sleep modal

Added fields for resting heart rate and average skin temperature deviation to the HealthSleepAddEditModalComponent, including support in form data, submission logic, and i18n translations for both English and Portuguese. Updated documentation to mention DB_HOST as a required environment variable. #426

subject: Move sleep scoring doc to features section
message:
Move sleep scoring doc to features section

Added new 'Features' section in docs. Renamed 'sleep-scoring.md' from 'getting-started' to 'features' and updated mkdocs.yml navigation to reflect this change.

subject: Update and expand documentation screenshots and gallery
message:
Update and expand documentation screenshots and gallery

Added new screenshots for health, settings, and authentication pages, updated several existing images, and removed obsolete ones. The gallery documentation was updated to reflect the new and reorganized screenshots, providing a more comprehensive and up-to-date visual overview of the application's UI. Minor formatting cleanups were also made in the developer and getting started guides.

subject: Update gallery screenshots and documentation
message:
Update gallery screenshots and documentation

Replaced login, reset password modal, and sign-up screenshots in the gallery. Updated gallery.md to specify that images should be 1000x1000 pixels. Also updated the login asset in the frontend.

subject: Update docs and roadmap for features and trademark
message:
Update docs and roadmap for features and trademark

Updated trademark notice to reflect registered status. Revised ROADMAP.md to replace multiple security features with passkey support. Updated docs/index.md to reflect new logging features, sign-up options, SSO support, and linked to ROADMAP.md for planned features.

subject: Fix incorrect units on public links
message:
Fix incorrect units on public links

ActivitySummaryComponent.vue updated distance, elevation, pace, and speed formatting to use the 'units' prop instead of accessing user units directly from the store, improving prop usage and component reusability. #433

subject: Improve formatting and consistency in health and activity components
message:
Improve formatting and consistency in health and activity components Refactored several Vue components to improve code readability and consistency, mainly by expanding multi-attribute HTML tags and aligning code style. Removed unnecessary
tags before 'NoItemsFoundComponent' in health zones. Updated i18n JSON files for formatting consistency and added a missing key in the health dashboard US locale.

subject: Refactor health zones and user goals layout and loading
message:
Refactor health zones and user goals layout and loading

Updated HealthSleepZone, HealthStepsZone, and HealthWeightZone components to improve layout consistency by wrapping content in a styled div and adjusting loading and empty state handling. Refactored SettingsUserGoals to use a responsive row layout for the add goal button and modal. These changes enhance UI consistency and maintainability. This improves UX consistency throughout the project

subject: Fix wrong column types on v0.16.0 migration
message: Fix wrong column types on v0.16.0 migration

subject: Support SMTP_PASSWORD as Docker secret
message:
Support SMTP_PASSWORD as Docker secret

Updated the application to read SMTP_PASSWORD using the read_secret method, enabling support for Docker secrets via SMTP_PASSWORD_FILE. Documentation was updated to reflect this new option for configuring SMTP credentials.

subject: Add pagination metadata to health API list responses
message:
Add pagination metadata to health API list responses

Updated the list response schemas and routers for health_sleep, health_steps, and health_weight to include num_records and page_number fields. This provides clients with additional pagination metadata alongside the total count and records.

subject: Add assertions for num_records and page_number in pagination tests
message:
Add assertions for num_records and page_number in pagination tests

Updated health_sleep, health_steps, and health_weight router pagination tests to assert num_records and page_number in response data, improving test coverage for pagination metadata.

subject: Add mobile SSO implementation guide to authentication docs
message:
Add mobile SSO implementation guide to authentication docs

Expanded the authentication documentation with a detailed step-by-step guide for implementing OAuth/SSO in mobile applications using WebView. The new section covers prerequisites, provider discovery, WebView handling, token extraction, secure storage, authenticated API requests, and token refresh logic.

subject: Add PKCE and server-side OAuth state for mobile SSO
message:
Add PKCE and server-side OAuth state for mobile SSO

Implements database-backed OAuth state management to support secure PKCE flows for mobile SSO. Adds new models, CRUD, and scheduled cleanup for OAuth state, updates identity provider login and callback flows to use server-side state, and introduces a token exchange endpoint for mobile clients. Updates session and rate limiting logic, and maintains backward compatibility for web clients using cookie-based state.

subject: Refactor OAuth state retrieval and fix datetime usage
message:
Refactor OAuth state retrieval and fix datetime usage

Reordered parameters in get_oauth_state_by_id for consistency and updated its usage in identity provider service. Also removed timezone awareness from datetime comparison to prevent potential issues.
