subject: Enforce OAuth 2.1 PKCE, unify token handling, and add MFA lockout
message:
Enforce OAuth 2.1 PKCE, unify token handling, and add MFA lockout

This update enforces PKCE for all OAuth flows, removes legacy cookie-based state, and unifies token handling for both web and mobile clients to comply with OAuth 2.1. It introduces a progressive lockout mechanism for MFA to prevent brute-force attacks, updates CSRF middleware to require only the header, and ensures refresh tokens are set as httpOnly cookies with SameSite=Strict. The frontend is updated to restore tokens on app initialization and handle SSO token exchange failures. Various backend endpoints and utilities are refactored for clarity, security, and consistency.

subject: Add middleware for security HTTP headers
message:
Add middleware for security HTTP headers

Introduced SecurityHeadersMiddleware to add essential security headers (e.g., X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and Content-Security-Policy) to all HTTP responses. Registered the middleware in main.py to enhance protection against common web vulnerabilities.

subject: Add session idle and absolute timeout enforcement
message:
Add session idle and absolute timeout enforcement

Implements optional session idle and absolute timeout logic, including new environment variables for configuration. Adds last_activity_at to sessions, enforces timeouts on token refresh, and introduces a scheduler job to clean up idle sessions. Also introduces progressive lockout for failed logins and updates documentation and examples accordingly.

subject: Refactor auth endpoints to use /auth/* paths
message:
Refactor auth endpoints to use /auth/* paths

Updated backend and frontend to use '/auth/login', '/auth/refresh', '/auth/mfa/verify', and '/auth/logout' endpoints instead of legacy paths. Adjusted CSRF middleware, route prefixes, tests, documentation, and service utilities to match the new endpoint structure for improved clarity and consistency.

subject: Add relationships for OAuthState to User and IdentityProvider
message:
Add relationships for OAuthState to User and IdentityProvider

Introduces SQLAlchemy relationships between OAuthState, User, and IdentityProvider models to enable easier navigation and cascading deletes. Updates the Alembic migration to add ON DELETE CASCADE to relevant foreign keys and improves column comments for clarity.

subject: Implement refresh token rotation and reuse detection
message:
Implement refresh token rotation and reuse detection

Adds rotated refresh token tracking to detect and prevent token reuse attacks. Introduces new models, schemas, and utilities for storing and checking rotated tokens, and invalidates all sessions in a token family if reuse is detected. Updates session and authentication logic to support token families, rotation counts, and last rotation timestamps. Includes Alembic migration for new columns and tables, and schedules cleanup of expired rotated tokens. Also improves frontend logout to refresh tokens before logging out.

subject: Update 401 retry logic in fetchWithRetry
message:
Update 401 retry logic in fetchWithRetry

Modified fetchWithRetry to remove 'auth/logout' from the list of endpoints that bypass retry on 401 errors to ensure proper session deletion on the DB. Updated comment to reflect the change.

subject: Implement CSRF token hash storage and validation for sessions
message:
Implement CSRF token hash storage and validation for sessions

Adds a hashed CSRF token field to the users_sessions table and model, updates session creation and refresh logic to store and validate the CSRF token hash, and enforces CSRF validation for web clients during token refresh. Updates middleware to require CSRF headers for web clients, and adds comprehensive tests for CSRF middleware behavior. Also improves frontend fetch utility to prevent concurrent refresh token requests. Fix access token not validated on private /idp routes

subject: Update CSP and expand authentication documentation
message:
Update CSP and expand authentication documentation

Enhanced the Content-Security-Policy header to allow inline images, styles, scripts, and OpenStreetMap tiles to allow frontend static serving from FastAPI.
Major expansion of authentication documentation: clarified OAuth 2.1 hybrid token storage, CSRF protection, refresh token rotation, session management, progressive account lockout, and best practices for web and mobile clients.

subject: Implement OAuth 2.1 CSRF bootstrap pattern for refresh
message:
Implement OAuth 2.1 CSRF bootstrap pattern for refresh

Adopts the OAuth 2.1 bootstrap pattern by not storing the CSRF token hash on initial login or token exchange, allowing the first /refresh call after a page reload to establish the CSRF binding. Updates CSRF validation logic to only require the CSRF token if provided, and documents the security model. Exempts the /refresh endpoint from CSRF middleware for the bootstrap scenario. Also ensures rotated refresh tokens are deleted when a session is deleted.

subject: Ensure timezone-aware datetime comparisons and OAuth state cleanup
message:
Ensure timezone-aware datetime comparisons and OAuth state cleanup

Updated identity provider service to use timezone-aware datetime comparisons for token age, refresh, and expiry checks. Added a function to delete OAuth state by ID and integrated OAuth state cleanup into session deletion to prevent orphaned records.

subject: Add MFA backup codes support for user authentication
message:
Add MFA backup codes support for user authentication

Introduces database models, migration, API endpoints, and business logic for MFA backup codes as a fallback authentication method. Users can generate, view status, and consume backup codes; codes are securely hashed and invalidated upon use. Integrates backup code verification into MFA flows, updates user and profile logic, and ensures codes are managed on MFA enable/disable actions.

message:

Added comprehensive unit tests for MFA backup codes CRUD, router, and utility functions, as well as for OAuth state CRUD and utility functions. Also fixed timezone handling in OAuth state expiry check. These tests improve coverage and reliability for authentication-related features.

message:
Add CASCADE ondelete to relevant foreign keys

Updated foreign key constraints in migration and model files to include ondelete="CASCADE" for idp_id, user_id, and token_family_id. This ensures related records are properly deleted when parent records are removed, improving data integrity and cleanup.

subject: Add script to restore Postgres from backup
message:
Add script to restore Postgres from backup

Introduces restore_postgres.sh for Endurain's demo instance to automate restoring the Postgres database from a backup, cleaning logs, pruning Docker images, and restarting containers. Includes usage instructions for scheduling via cron.

subject: Update settings sidebar translations for consistency
message:
Update settings sidebar translations for consistency

Standardized capitalization in the settingsSideBarComponent.json translation file to ensure consistency across section labels.

subject: Adding ability to set custom map tile server URL, attribution, and background color.
message: Adding ability to set custom map tile server URL, attribution, and background color.

message: fix: add missing mapping for eBile rides

subject: Refactor health modules into health namespace package
message:
Refactor health modules into health namespace package

Moved health_sleep, health_steps, health_targets, and health_weight modules into a unified health/ namespace package. Updated all imports and test references accordingly to improve code organization and maintainability.

subject: Bump version to 0.17.0 in backend and frontend
message:
Bump version to 0.17.0 in backend and frontend

Updated the version number to 0.17.0 in backend/pyproject.toml and frontend/app/package.json to reflect the new release.

subject: Add validation and sanitization to map settings schema
message:
Add validation and sanitization to map settings schema

Enhanced the ServerSettings Pydantic model with field constraints, a hex color regex, and custom validators for tileserver_url and tileserver_attribution to improve security and data integrity. The migration script was reformatted for clarity but retains the same logic.

subject: Bump version to v0.17.0 in backend and footer
message:
Bump version to v0.17.0 in backend and footer

Updated API_VERSION in backend config and version display in the frontend footer from v0.16.4 to v0.17.0. Also reformatted FooterComponent.vue for improved readability.

subject: Preserve HTML entities during content sanitization
message:
Preserve HTML entities during content sanitization

Updated the ServerSettings schema to extract and restore HTML entities before escaping dangerous content, ensuring entities are not double-escaped during sanitization.

subject: Add configurable log level support via LOG_LEVEL env var
message:
Add configurable log level support via LOG_LEVEL env var

Introduces a LOG_LEVEL environment variable to control application log verbosity. Updates configuration, logger setup, Docker startup script, and documentation to support and validate log levels (critical, error, warning, info, debug, trace). #461

subject: Defaulting LOG_LEVEL to info
message:
Defaulting LOG_LEVEL to info

Defaulting LOG_LEVEL to info to keep same behavior has before #461

subject: Fix distance label calculation in line chart
message:
Fix distance label calculation in line chart

Fix distance label calculation in line chart #465

subject: Refactor activity stream chart and add type definitions
message:
Refactor activity stream chart and add type definitions

Refactored ActivityStreamsLineChartComponent.vue to use <script setup> and TypeScript, modularized chart logic, and improved type safety. Added Activity, ActivityStream, and StreamWaypoint interfaces to types/index.ts for better type definitions. Minor formatting improvements in FooterComponent.vue and fixed newline in settingsSideBarComponent.json.

subject: Update Content Security Policy for Swagger UI support
message:
Update Content Security Policy for Swagger UI support

Expanded the Content-Security-Policy to allow resources from cdn.jsdelivr.net and fastapi.tiangolo.com, enabling Swagger UI functionality. Added a TODO note to consider serving Swagger UI locally to improve security.

subject: Format average speed to two decimal places
message:
Format average speed to two decimal places

Updated formatAverageSpeedMetric and formatAverageSpeedImperial to format speeds to two decimal places instead of rounding to whole numbers. Adjusted function documentation to reflect this change for improved precision in speed display. #466

subject: Add HIIT activity type support across app
message:
Add HIIT activity type support across app

Introduces HIIT (High Intensity Interval Training) as a new activity type (ID 46) throughout the backend and frontend. Updates activity mappings, goal calculations, FIT file parsing, UI components, i18n files, and documentation to support HIIT, including proper display, selection, and iconography. #458

subject: Add markdown support and sanitization for activity fields
message:
Add markdown support and sanitization for activity fields

Introduces markdown support for activity description and private notes fields in both backend and frontend. Adds new sanitization utilities using bleach on the backend and DOMPurify on the frontend to prevent XSS. Implements MarkdownContentComponent and MarkdownEditorComponent for rendering and editing markdown, updates activity summary and edit modals to use these components, and updates i18n strings. Adds bleach and related dependencies to backend, and dompurify, marked, and types for dompurify to frontend dependencies. #467

subject: Validate metabolic_age in body composition processing
message:
Validate metabolic_age in body composition processing

Adds a check to ensure metabolic_age values are within a reasonable range (1-150 years). Invalid values are set to None before creating HealthWeight objects. #462

subject: Fix carousel ID conflicts in ActivityMapComponent
message:
Fix carousel ID conflicts in ActivityMapComponent

Updated the carousel and its controls in ActivityMapComponent.vue to use a unique ID based on the activity ID, preventing conflicts when multiple carousels are rendered. #470
Also reformatted a conditional in health_utils.py for readability.

subject: Revert version to v0.16.5 across project
message:
Revert version to v0.16.5 across project

Downgraded version identifiers from v0.17.0 to v0.16.5 in backend and frontend configuration files and updated FooterComponent to display the correct version. This change ensures consistency with the intended release version.

subject: Add configurable password policy to server settings
message:
Add configurable password policy to server settings

Introduces server-configurable password policy options, allowing selection between 'strict' (complexity requirements) and 'length_only' (minimum length only) policies, with separate minimum length settings for regular and admin users. Updates backend models, schema, migration, and user creation logic to enforce these policies. Frontend forms and validation now dynamically reflect and enforce the current server password policy, and UI components/settings are updated to allow admins to configure these options. #451

subject: Add activity type checks for snow and water sports
message:
Add activity type checks for snow and water sports

Introduced utility functions to identify snow skiing, snowboarding, stand-up paddling, and surf activities. Updated ActivityView to use these checks and assign appropriate gear types for these activities. #472

subject: Refactor server settings module and improve API docs
message:
Refactor server settings module and improve API docs

Refactored the server settings module for better structure and clarity, including splitting base and public schemas, updating SQLAlchemy model to use Mapped/mapped_column, and improving type hints and docstrings. Enhanced API endpoints with detailed documentation, added file validation for login photo upload, and improved error handling. The __init__.py now provides explicit exports for all key components.

subject: Refactor WebSocket manager and authentication flow
message:
Refactor WebSocket manager and authentication flow

Replaces websocket.schema with websocket.manager for managing WebSocket connections, introducing a singleton WebSocketManager and updating all imports and usages accordingly. Adds token-based authentication for WebSocket connections, requiring access_token as a query parameter and validating it server-side. Updates FastAPI WebSocket endpoint to use authenticated user ID, and modifies frontend to connect using the access token. Removes obsolete schema.py and improves error handling and logging for WebSocket events.

subject: Add tile map templates API and async file ops to server settings
message:
Add tile map templates API and async file ops to server settings

Introduces endpoints for listing available tile map templates in both public and authenticated server settings routers. Adds schema and utility logic for tile map templates. Refactors login photo upload and delete operations to use aiofiles for asynchronous file handling. Improves type annotations, docstrings, and error handling in server settings modules. Updates dependencies to include aiofiles.

subject: Add tile map template selection to server settings
message:
Add tile map template selection to server settings

Introduces a tile server template selector in the server settings UI, allowing users to choose from predefined tile map templates or specify custom settings. Adds backend support for template metadata including background color, updates API endpoints, and enhances frontend logic to handle template selection, warnings, and automatic field population. Also updates i18n strings and service methods for template retrieval.

subject: Add comprehensive tests for server_settings and websocket modules
message:
Add comprehensive tests for server_settings and websocket modules

Added new test suites for server_settings CRUD, models, routers, and public endpoints, as well as websocket manager, router, and utils. Expanded auth and token_manager tests to cover error handling and edge cases. Updated pytest configuration to support public endpoint testing. Refactored test directory structure to mirror backend modules for health features.

subject: Refactor health targets and server settings modules
message:
Refactor health targets and server settings modules

Improved health targets CRUD logic, updated models to use SQLAlchemy 2.0 style, and split Pydantic schemas for read/update operations with validation. Enhanced error handling in health targets and server settings CRUD functions. Updated FastAPI routers to use new schemas and response models, and made login photo deletion asynchronous with proper status codes.

subject: Refactor health sleep module for improved type safety
message:
Refactor health sleep module for improved type safety

Refactored the health_sleep module to use stricter Pydantic types (StrictInt, StrictStr, Field) and separated schemas into HealthSleepBase, HealthSleepCreate, HealthSleepUpdate, and HealthSleepRead for clearer API contracts. Updated SQLAlchemy models to use type annotations and mapped_column for better type safety. CRUD functions now use SQLAlchemy Core select statements and return ORM models directly. Router endpoints and response models were updated to match the new schemas, and validation logic was moved to Pydantic fields. Also improved the health_targets schema with stricter types and removed legacy field validators.

subject: Refactor health steps and sleep modules for improved API consistency
message:
Refactor health steps and sleep modules for improved API consistency

Refactored health_steps and health_sleep modules to improve API consistency, error handling, and schema documentation. Updated CRUD functions to use SQLAlchemy Core select statements, improved exception handling, and ensured correct HTTP status codes. Enhanced Pydantic schemas with stricter typing, field validation, and clearer docstrings. Updated routers to return proper response models and status codes. Also made minor improvements to health_targets and server_settings routers for status code consistency.

subject: Refactor health_weight module and improve CRUD operations
message:
Refactor health_weight module and improve CRUD operations

Refactors the health_weight module to use distinct Pydantic schemas for create, update, and read operations, and updates all related CRUD, router, and utility functions to use these schemas. Improves type safety, validation, and error handling in health_weight CRUD functions, and updates the health_weight model to use SQLAlchemy 2.0 style with mapped_column. Adds module-level __init__.py for health_weight, updates API endpoints to return correct response models, and ensures BMI is calculated and updated consistently. Also adds indexes for health_steps and health_weight tables in the Alembic migration, and makes minor docstring and type improvements in related modules.

subject: Refactor health sleep and steps tests for SQLAlchemy 2.0 style
message:
Refactor health sleep and steps tests for SQLAlchemy 2.0 style

Updated health_sleep and health_steps CRUD and router tests to use SQLAlchemy 2.0 style session.execute() and scalars() instead of legacy query/filter patterns. Adjusted test schemas to use new HealthSleepRead, HealthSleepBase, HealthStepsRead, and HealthStepsBase models, and updated test cases to reflect schema and validation changes. Also improved test coverage for date auto-filling and error handling, and ensured all test mocks and assertions align with the refactored CRUD implementations.

subject: Improve token validation logging levels
message:
Improve token validation logging levels

Logging for token validation errors now uses 'debug' level for expired tokens and 'error' for other issues, providing more granular log output.

subject: Include user_id in health update schemas
message:
Include user_id in health update schemas

Adds missing user_id to HealthWeightUpdate, HealthStepsUpdate, and HealthSleepUpdate.

subject: Add support for parsing monitoring and monitoring_hr_data frames
message: Add support for parsing monitoring and monitoring_hr_data frames

subject: Add dynamic tile domain support for CSP headers
message:
Add dynamic tile domain support for CSP headers

Content Security Policy (CSP) img-src domains for map tiles are now dynamically determined from server settings and updated on startup and when settings change. Introduces utility functions to extract tile domains, updates middleware to use app state for allowed domains, and adds comprehensive tests for domain extraction and allowed domain logic.

subject: Refactor user privacy settings models and API usage
message:
Refactor user privacy settings models and API usage

Refactored user privacy settings backend to use distinct Pydantic schemas for read, create, and update operations. Improved type safety and validation, updated SQLAlchemy model to use new mapping style, and enhanced CRUD error handling. Updated API endpoints and frontend to align with new schema structure and removed unnecessary user_id field from frontend update payload.

subject: Bump version to 0.16.6 across backend and frontend
message:
Bump version to 0.16.6 across backend and frontend

Updated API version, package versions, and footer display to 0.16.6 in both backend and frontend to reflect the new release.

subject: Add user privacy settings tests and migration
message:
Add user privacy settings tests and migration

Introduces comprehensive unit tests for user privacy settings CRUD, models, and schema. Adds Alembic migration to enforce unique index on users_privacy_settings.user_id. Logger setup now uses configurable log level for Alembic and APScheduler loggers.

subject: Support access token in query param for browser redirects
message:
Support access token in query param for browser redirects

Updated backend to accept access tokens via query parameter for browser redirect scenarios, raising an error if missing. Frontend now appends the access token as a query parameter when redirecting, ensuring compatibility with browsers that cannot set custom headers. #478

subject: Implement secure one-time tokens for IdP account linking
message:
Implement secure one-time tokens for IdP account linking

Adds backend and frontend support for one-time, short-lived tokens to securely link identity providers to user accounts. Introduces new backend models, CRUD, and utility functions for IdP link tokens, updates OAuth link flow to use these tokens instead of access tokens in query parameters, and adjusts related API endpoints and Vue components. Improves security by preventing token replay, limiting token lifetime, and removing access token exposure in browser redirects. Also updates i18n files for new error messages and improves frontend UX for linking providers.

subject: Use dynamic :value binding for select options
message:
Use dynamic :value binding for select options

Replaced static value attributes with Vue's dynamic :value binding in all <option> elements. This ensures correct data types are used for v-model bindings, improving form behavior and preventing type coercion issues.

subject: Add comprehensive tests for IdP link tokens and core modules
message:
Add comprehensive tests for IdP link tokens and core modules

This commit adds extensive unit tests for IdP link tokens CRUD and utility functions, identity provider token management, MFA backup codes schema and CRUD, OAuth state utilities, core cryptography, and authentication schema and security modules. It also updates existing tests to improve exception handling and coverage for edge cases such as expired lockouts, token validation errors, and token creation for different user types.

subject: Refactor user integrations module and improve type safety
message:
Refactor user integrations module and improve type safety

Refactored user integrations CRUD, models, and schemas for improved type safety, clearer docstrings, and better error handling. Updated references in Garmin and Strava utility modules to use models instead of schemas for ORM objects. Added a comprehensive __init__.py for user_integrations, and enhanced Pydantic schemas for validation and clarity.

subject: Refactor user privacy settings imports and usage
message:
Refactor user privacy settings imports and usage

Updated all references to user privacy settings to consistently use the 'users_privacy_settings_models' and 'users_privacy_settings_schema' import names. Changed function signatures and test mocks to use the correct model and schema classes, improving code clarity and maintainability.

subject: Update users_integrations index and add column comments
message:
Update users_integrations index and add column comments

Makes the users_integrations_user_id index unique and adds comments to garminconnect_oauth1 and garminconnect_oauth2 columns. Downgrade reverses these changes, restoring the index to non-unique and removing the comments.

subject: Add encrypted tile server API key to server settings
message:
Add encrypted tile server API key to server settings

Introduces a new 'tileserver_api_key' field to server settings, stored encrypted in the backend and exposed to admins via a decrypted API. Updates the database schema, backend models, API endpoints, and frontend settings UI to support secure management of the tile server API key. Also bumps version to 0.16.7 across backend and frontend.

subject: Add API key warning to server settings zone
message:
Add API key warning to server settings zone

Introduced a warning message in the SettingsServerSettingsZone component to inform users that changing the tile template will reset the API key. Updated i18n strings to include the new warning and made minor adjustments to existing warning messages.

subject: Refactor and extend user identity provider management
message:
Refactor and extend user identity provider management

Adds utility functions and batch enrichment for user identity provider links, improves CRUD error handling, and updates API endpoints to avoid N+1 queries. Refactors models and schemas for clarity and type safety, and introduces comprehensive docstrings. Includes new and updated tests for batch identity provider retrieval.

subject: Add Swedish language support to app
message:
Add Swedish language support to app

Introduces Swedish ('sv') as a supported language across backend and frontend. Updates language switchers, user profile, and user modals to include Swedish. Adds Swedish translation files for all relevant UI components and views, and updates i18n configuration to bundle and recognize Swedish locale.

subject: Refactor user goals backend and improve duration input UI
message:
Refactor user goals backend and improve duration input UI

Backend user goals module was refactored for improved type safety, validation, and error handling. CRUD, models, schemas, and utilities now use stricter types, clearer docstrings, and more robust validation. The frontend goal duration input was updated to use separate hours and minutes fields for better usability.

subject: Add tests for user goals module and update router config
message:
Add tests for user goals module and update router config

Added comprehensive unit tests for user goals CRUD, dependencies, models, router, schema, and utility functions. Updated test configuration to include the user_goals router. Minor formatting adjustment in the user goals schema for consistency.

subject: Refactor user goals to use string enums and add filtering
message:
Refactor user goals to use string enums and add filtering

Migrates user goal activity_type and goal_type from integer to string enums in the backend and database, updating all related models, schemas, and tests. Adds filtering by interval, activity type, and goal type to the user goals API and frontend, including new filter UI components and improved i18n support. Updates all usages and tests to use string values for activity and goal types.

subject: Fix UI comments and layout in Health and Goals components
message:
Fix UI comments and layout in Health and Goals components

Corrected a comment in HealthWeightListComponent.vue to reference weight details instead of sleep details. Added 'd-flex' class to a div in GoalsListComponent.vue to improve layout for the edit goal button.

subject: Refactor user default gear and user goals schemas and APIs
message:
Refactor user default gear and user goals schemas and APIs

Refactored user_default_gear and user_goals modules for improved schema validation, stricter field constraints, and clearer API contracts. Updated Pydantic schemas to use stricter types and field validation, improved CRUD and router logic to prevent editing another user's data, and unified update endpoints to expect full objects with id and user_id. Adjusted tests and frontend to match new API requirements. Also improved docstrings and code comments for maintainability.

subject: Add tests for user_default_gear module
message:
Add tests for user_default_gear module

Introduce unit tests for the users.user_default_gear module, including CRUD operations, models, schemas, and utility functions. These tests improve coverage and help ensure correct behavior for user default gear management.

subject: Refactor users pagination API and update frontend usage
message:
Refactor users pagination API and update frontend usage

Replaces the separate users number endpoint with a unified paginated users endpoint returning both user records and total count. Updates backend response model and frontend components/services to use the new structure, removing the now-unnecessary getUsersNumber call and simplifying data fetching logic.

subject: Refactor DB error handling with decorator and cleanup
message:
Refactor DB error handling with decorator and cleanup

Introduced a core.decorators.handle_db_errors decorator to centralize and standardize SQLAlchemy error handling across CRUD modules. Refactored health, user, and server_settings CRUD files to remove repetitive try/except blocks, replacing them with the new decorator. Updated related function calls and imports, and simplified code for better maintainability. Also updated user photo and MFA update methods for consistency.

subject: Refactor variable names and round duration in utils
message:
Refactor variable names and round duration in utils

Renamed 'websocket_manager' to 'ws_manager' for consistency across activity router and related functions. Updated type hint for ws_manager in activity_utils.py. Applied rounding to total_duration in user_goals/utils.py to ensure consistent data formatting. #488

subject: Refactor file upload handling and async user photo management
message:
Refactor file upload handling and async user photo management

Centralizes file upload logic in a new core.file_uploads module with security validation and async I/O. Refactors user and server settings image upload endpoints to use the new handler, and updates user photo CRUD operations to be asynchronous. Replaces direct file system operations with async equivalents, improves error handling, and updates related frontend logic to match new API responses. Also standardizes server settings access to use get_server_settings_or_404 and makes several migration and CRUD functions async for consistency.

subject: Improve DB error handling and update tests
message:
Improve DB error handling and update tests

Enhanced the handle_db_errors decorator to automatically rollback the session on SQLAlchemy errors. Updated related CRUD and test files to use the new error handling and session rollback logic. Refactored test mocks to use scalar_one and get_server_settings_or_404, and fixed test coverage for user default gear creation and user authentication. Also updated frontend user edit modal to handle external_auth_count after edit.

subject: Refactor user profile endpoint to use model_copy for response
message:
Refactor user profile endpoint to use model_copy for response

Updated the read_users_me endpoint to construct the UserMe response using model_validate and model_copy, ensuring integration and privacy settings are included in the response. This approach improves clarity and maintainability by avoiding direct mutation of the user model.

subject: Remove birthdate formatting from user creation response
message:
Remove birthdate formatting from user creation response

The create_user endpoint now returns the created user object directly instead of formatting the birthdate. The unused format_user_birthdate utility function has been removed for code simplification.

subject: Add docstrings and improve user module exports
message:
Add docstrings and improve user module exports

Added comprehensive docstrings to routers and dependencies for better API documentation and clarity. Updated __init__.py to explicitly export CRUD functions, schemas, models, enums, and utilities. Minor refactoring in routers to improve type hints, argument naming, and return values for consistency.

subject: Refactor profile module: add MFA store, improve API, and update frontend
message:
Refactor profile module: add MFA store, improve API, and update frontend

Move MFASecretStore to own file for segregation of concerns. Refactors and documents profile-related modules, improves API endpoint consistency (status codes, response models), and updates MFA enable/disable endpoints to use PUT. Updates frontend components and services to match new event and API conventions, adds Strava state management, and synchronizes sidebar section state with URL query parameters for better navigation and UX.

subject: Improve IdP user sync and import validation
message:
Improve IdP user sync and import validation

Refactored identity provider user info sync to update user fields only if changes are detected and to handle email conflicts gracefully. Updated user creation to use actual server settings. Enhanced import service to validate existence of identity providers before linking, preventing errors when providers are missing.

subject: Refactor file upload handling and improve import robustness
message:
Refactor file upload handling and improve import robustness

Centralizes file saving logic with a new `save_file` utility, updates all usages related to user to use the new function, and ensures image validation is consistently applied. The import service now properly converts string numeric fields to floats/ints, removes database IDs from imported objects, and uses async file saving for all imported files. Also updates frontend gear fetching logic and upgrades several dependencies.

subject: Migrate user enums from integers to strings
message:
Migrate user enums from integers to strings

Refactored user-related enums (gender, access_type, first_day_of_week) in the backend and frontend from integer values to string values for improved clarity and maintainability. Updated Alembic migration to convert existing data, adjusted SQLAlchemy models, Pydantic schemas, and all related logic and UI components to use string-based enums. This change affects user creation, editing, display, and authentication logic throughout the application.

subject: Differentiate token delivery for web and mobile clients
message: Differentiate token delivery for web and mobile clients

subject: Migrate units and currency fields to string enums
message:
Migrate units and currency fields to string enums

Refactor units and currency fields in both backend and frontend from integer values to string enums (e.g., 'metric', 'imperial', 'euro', 'dollar', 'pound'). Update database migration, models, schemas, and all related frontend components and logic to use string values instead of numeric codes.

subject: Migrate activity visibility from int to string enum
message:
Migrate activity visibility from int to string enum

Refactor backend and frontend to use string values ('public', 'followers', 'private') for default_activity_visibility instead of integers. Updates database migration, models, schemas, and all related frontend components and stores to reflect this change.

subject: Rename user modules and relationships to 'users'
message:
Rename user modules and relationships to 'users'

Refactored all imports, relationships, and references from 'user' to 'users' across backend modules for consistency. Updated model relationship names, schemas, and CRUD/service calls to use the plural form, and adjusted migration and utility logic accordingly.

subject: Add mobile password login with PKCE and schema defaults
message:
Add mobile password login with PKCE and schema defaults

Implements PKCE support for mobile password authentication, allowing mobile clients to use a secure token exchange flow similar to OAuth/SSO. Updates authentication endpoints, schemas, and documentation to support PKCE parameters and session-based token exchange for mobile clients. Also standardizes Pydantic schema field defaults using the `default` argument for improved OpenAPI and client code generation.

subject: Add signup rate limit and improve user creation security
message:
Add signup rate limit and improve user creation security

Introduces a rate limit for signup attempts to prevent account creation abuse. Improves user creation error handling by providing a more generic error message to reduce information leakage. Also includes minor refactoring and logging improvements in session and identity provider logic. Dependency updates for backend and frontend packages are included.

subject: Refactor tests for enum string values and user relationships
message:
Refactor tests for enum string values and user relationships

Updated tests to use string values for enums (Units, Currency, ActivityVisibility) instead of integers, reflecting schema changes. Changed model relationship attribute checks from 'user' to 'users' across health, gear, goals, identity provider, integrations, and privacy settings tests. Adjusted assertions and test data to match new enum and relationship conventions.

subject: Improve authentication error handling and messages
message:
Improve authentication error handling and messages

Added explicit HTTP 401 exception for insecure token claims in TokenManager. Updated error messages in authenticate_user to use a generic authentication failure message for both username and password errors, enhancing security and impersonation

subject: Switch rotated token hashing to HMAC-SHA256 for reuse checks
message:
Switch rotated token hashing to HMAC-SHA256 for reuse checks

Updated refresh token reuse detection to use HMAC-SHA256 with the server secret for deterministic and secure token hashing and lookup. Refactored related utility functions and updated their usage in the auth router. Also reduced the scheduler interval for cleaning up expired rotated tokens from 5 to 1 minute.

subject: Refactor session module to users_session namespace
message:
Refactor session module to users_session namespace

Moved all session-related files and imports from 'session' to 'users/users_session' to improve code organization and clarity. Updated all references throughout the codebase and tests to use the new namespace.

subject: Refactor user session and rotated token modules
message:
Refactor user session and rotated token modules

Refactored user session and rotated refresh token modules for improved maintainability and consistency. Introduced explicit __init__.py exports, switched to SQLAlchemy 2.0 style models, added and improved Pydantic schemas, and replaced raw SQLAlchemy queries with select/delete statements. Added core_decorators.handle_db_errors for error handling, improved docstrings, and updated API router response models. This refactor also enhances type safety, code clarity, and aligns with modern FastAPI/SQLAlchemy best practices.

subject: Update auth tests to check for unified error messages
message:
Update auth tests to check for unified error messages

Modified authentication and token manager tests to assert on the new unified error message 'Unable to authenticate' and to check for HTTP 401 status with specific detail in insecure claim scenarios.

subject: Add tests for user session and rotated refresh tokens
message:
Add tests for user session and rotated refresh tokens

Introduce comprehensive test suites for user session and rotated refresh token functionality, including CRUD operations, model and schema validation, and utility functions. These tests improve coverage and reliability for session management and token rotation logic.

subject: Support nullable refresh_token for PKCE sessions
message:
Support nullable refresh_token for PKCE sessions

Refactor session creation and models to allow nullable refresh_token, enabling PKCE/SSO flows to create sessions before token exchange. Update related logic, validation, and tests to handle sessions without refresh tokens. Improve error handling and logging for authentication and token refresh endpoints. Update OAuth state lookup to ensure only unused states are accepted.

subject: Update login.png asset
message:
Update login.png asset

Replaces the existing login.png image with a new version in the assets directory.

subject: Update logout to use refresh token and improve docs
message:
Update logout to use refresh token and improve docs

Changed the /logout endpoint to validate and extract session info from the refresh token instead of the access token. Updated authentication documentation to clarify differences between web and mobile endpoints, including logout and token usage.

subject: PKCE for mobile now follows SSO logic for state and nonce
message: PKCE for mobile now follows SSO logic for state and nonce

subject: Add health fasting tracking feature
message:
Add health fasting tracking feature

Introduces health fasting tracking with new models, CRUD operations, API endpoints, and schemas. Adds Alembic migration for the health_fasting table and a 'fasting' field to health_targets. Updates user and health_targets models, schemas, and routes to support fasting data. Adjusts frontend and test router prefixes for consistency.

subject: Add required fields and button validation to gear modal
message:
Add required fields and button validation to gear modal

Added 'required' attributes to brand and model fields in GearComponentAddEditModalComponent.vue and disabled the add/edit buttons unless all fields are filled. Updated i18n with a new 'filterOptionsLabel' key and adjusted GearView.vue to use the new label for accessibility. #500

subject: Bump version to 0.17.1 and update dependencies
message:
Bump version to 0.17.1 and update dependencies

Updated backend and frontend version numbers to 0.17.1. Upgraded several backend Python dependencies (markdown, packaging, pycparser, sqlalchemy) and frontend Rollup dependencies to their latest versions. Also updated the FooterComponent.vue to reflect the new version.

subject: Urlencode the Smtp Username and Password, otherwise authentication will fail if they contain characters like =, & etc.
message: Urlencode the Smtp Username and Password, otherwise authentication will fail if they contain characters like =, & etc.

subject: Add advanced user filtering to users list
message:
Add advanced user filtering to users list

Introduces new filters for inactive, email unverified, pending approval, external auth, and local auth users in the users list. Updates backend API and frontend components to support these filters, including UI changes for filter dropdowns and i18n labels.

subject: Fix birthdate year extraction in HR calculation
message:
Fix birthdate year extraction in HR calculation

Attempt fix for #503

subject: Return numbers instead of strings in unit conversion utils
message:
Return numbers instead of strings in unit conversion utils

Updated unit conversion functions in unitsUtils.js to return numbers instead of string representations. Also changed a translation key in UserGoalsStatsComponent.vue from 'unitsFt' to 'unitsFeetShort'.

subject: Add validator to convert avg_sleep_stress to int
message:
Add validator to convert avg_sleep_stress to int

Introduced a field validator for avg_sleep_stress in HealthSleepBase to ensure Decimal and float values are converted to int. Attempt fix for #506

subject: Fix elevation data conversion in line chart
message:
Fix elevation data conversion in line chart

Removed unnecessary parseFloat when converting elevation to feet in ActivityStreamsLineChartComponent.vue.

message:

subject: Refine boolean checks in user pagination filters
message:
Refine boolean checks in user pagination filters

Updated conditional checks in get_users_with_pagination to explicitly compare against False, improving clarity and preventing unintended filtering when parameters are None.

subject: Add interval filtering for health weight data
message:
Add interval filtering for health weight data

Introduces interval-based filtering for health weight records in both backend and frontend. Adds a new Interval enum and utility for date calculation in the backend, updates API endpoints and CRUD logic to support interval queries, and refactors frontend components to allow users to filter weight data by time intervals. Also updates i18n files and cleans up unused code in HealthView.vue.

subject: Add interval filtering to health steps and fixs for weight logic
message:
Add interval filtering to health steps and fixs for weight logic

Introduces an interval filter to health steps and the frontend components, allowing users to filter records by time intervals (e.g., last 7 days, last 30 days). Updates backend CRUD and router logic, adjusts frontend components for new filter controls, and refactors pagination and data fetching to support interval-based queries.

subject: Refactor sleep and steps endpoints to use pagination and interval filters
message:
Refactor sleep and steps endpoints to use pagination and interval filters

Removed deprecated 'get_all_health_sleep_by_user_id' and 'get_all_health_steps_by_user_id' endpoints and their usages. Updated backend and frontend to use paginated endpoints with interval filtering for sleep and steps data. Refactored related tests, components, and i18n files. Improved chart rendering logic to handle loading states and single data points. Cleaned up unused props and streamlined data flow in HealthView and related components.

subject: Refactor health endpoints to use query-based pagination
message:
Refactor health endpoints to use query-based pagination

Updated health_sleep, health_steps, and health_weight endpoints to accept pagination parameters (page_number, num_records) as query parameters instead of path parameters. Renamed CRUD functions for clarity (e.g., get_health_sleep_with_pagination -> get_health_sleep_with_pagination_by_user_id) and updated all usages, imports, and tests accordingly. Added a new dependency for validating pagination values from query parameters. Adjusted test cases and patches to match the new function names and endpoint signatures.

subject: Refactor user pagination to use query parameters
message:
Refactor user pagination to use query parameters

Updated backend and frontend to handle user pagination via query parameters instead of path parameters. The API endpoint now accepts optional 'page_number' and 'num_records' as query parameters, and the frontend service constructs the query string accordingly. Improved docstrings and parameter handling for better flexibility and clarity.

subject: Refactor health data pagination and streak logic
message:
Refactor health data pagination and streak logic

Unified and renamed pagination CRUD functions for health_fasting, health_sleep, health_steps, and health_weight modules to use consistent get_*_by_user_id naming. Moved fasting streak calculation logic to a new utils module. Updated routers, tests, and __init__.py exports to match new function names and signatures. Improved interval filtering and documentation for health_fasting endpoints.

subject: Refactor health schemas and fasting model fields
message:
Refactor health schemas and fasting model fields

Consolidates paginated list response schemas for health modules into a shared HealthListResponse base class. Refactors health_fasting model and schema to remove timezone and local/UTC fields, using fast_start_time and fast_end_time instead. Updates related CRUD, migration, and utility code to match new field names and structure.

subject: Add consolidated health dashboard API and frontend integration
message:
Add consolidated health dashboard API and frontend integration

Introduces a new backend FastAPI router and schema for consolidated health dashboard data, providing a single endpoint for daily stats (sleep, weight, steps, fasting). Adds a corresponding frontend service and updates HealthDashboardZoneComponent to fetch and display this data. Also includes UI/UX improvements, i18n updates, and refactors dashboard logic to use the new API.

subject: Include refresh_token_expires_in in token responses
message:
Include refresh_token_expires_in in token responses

Expose refresh_token_expires_in across auth flows: add the field to the TokenExchangeResponse schema, compute and include refresh token expiry in token exchange and refresh endpoints (public identity provider router and auth router), update utils.complete_login to return it, and update developer docs/examples. This lets clients know the refresh token lifetime alongside access token info. #514

subject: Offload blocking API calls to asyncio threads
message:
Offload blocking API calls to asyncio threads

Add guidance doc and prevent blocking the asyncio event loop by running synchronous client calls in a thread pool.

- Added .github/agents/se-gitops-ci-specialist.agent.md: DevOps/CI & GitOps specialist guidance for pipelines, debugging, and best practices.
- backend/app/garmin/activity_utils.py: import asyncio and wrap garminconnect_client.get_activities_by_date, get_activity_gear, and download_activity with await asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking the event loop.
- backend/app/strava/activity_utils.py: import asyncio and run strava_client.get_activities and parse_activity via asyncio.to_thread (parse_activity performs blocking HTTP calls). Added explanatory comments.

These changes keep the async event loop responsive when using third-party synchronous libraries.

subject: Return expires_in in seconds; trust X-Client-Type
message:
Return expires_in in seconds; trust X-Client-Type

Change token endpoints and utils to return expires_in and refresh_token_expires_in as seconds-until-expiry (RFC 6749 §5.1) by computing (expiry - now).total_seconds() instead of returning epoch timestamps. Update docs examples and frontend type comments to reflect the new semantics. Also make token-exchange determine client_type from the X-Client-Type request header (with fallback/sanitization) because stored oauth_state.client_type can be missing for system browser flows.

subject: Replace Docker workflows; add publish and docs
message:
Replace Docker workflows; add publish and docs

Remove two legacy workflows (docker-image_latest_manual.yml and docker-image_manualORnewrelease.yml) and introduce a consolidated docker-publish.yml that builds and pushes multi-arch Docker images to ghcr.io. The new workflow uses updated actions (checkout@v4, setup-qemu@v3, setup-buildx@v3, docker/login-action, docker/metadata-action and docker/build-push-action), adds permissions, concurrency, caching, and improved tagging (semver, latest on release, dev-<sha> on manual runs).

Also add docs.yml to deploy MkDocs documentation to GitHub Pages on pushes to master that touch docs, mkdocs.yml, or backend Python files; it sets up Python 3.13 and installs mkdocs-material and mkdocstrings. Overall this modernizes CI, consolidates Docker publishing, and adds automated docs deployment.

subject: Bump to v0.18.0 and tidy health components
message:
Bump to v0.18.0 and tidy health components

Bump application version to v0.18.0 (backend config, backend pyproject, frontend package.json and footer display). Clean up and reformat several frontend files for readability: HealthDashboardZoneComponent (template/icon/span formatting and multiline null checks), HealthView.vue (multiline component props), healthService.js (import formatting), and a small i18n newline/format fix. These are primarily stylistic/formatting changes with no functional behavior changes.

subject: Add health fasting UI and normalize time formatting
message:
Add health fasting UI and normalize time formatting

Introduce full Health Fasting feature and refactor time handling across the app. Added new components for fasting: HealthFastingZone, HealthFastingAddEditModalComponent, HealthFastingListComponent, plus a health_fasting service and i18n entries. Updated HealthDashboardZone and HealthSideBar to surface fasting, improved null-safety when reading dashboard sleep/steps fields, and wired modal/target controls and pagination. Standardized duration formatting across many activity/gear components to new dateTime utils (formatSecondsToHoursMinutes, formatSecondsToHoursMinutesSeconds, formatSecondsToHours) and updated imports. Backend: make fasting start/end times timezone-naive before computing actual_duration in complete_health_fasting to avoid timezone-aware subtraction issues. Misc: UI tweaks (progress, badges, buttons) and minor cleanup to collapse/edit/delete handling in fasting list.

subject: Add fasting card, sidebar tweaks, and placeholder
message:
Add fasting card, sidebar tweaks, and placeholder

Add a Fasting card to the Health dashboard showing active fast, elapsed time, fasting type, and target comparison. Compute activeFasting and activeFastingElapsed in onMounted (handles in-progress fasts and actual duration). Update Health sidebar spacing for icons and mark the fasting section with a beta tag. Add a reusable CardPlaceholderComponent for skeleton loading UI. Add i18n strings for fasting and no fasting target.

subject: Refactor TCX parsing utils and add docs
message:
Refactor TCX parsing utils and add docs

Introduce a tcx package export and comprehensively refactor utils.py: add docstrings and type hints, split parsing into helpers (_parse_lap_power, _parse_laps, _extract_waypoints, _build_activity), improve error handling and logging, integrate FastAPI HTTPException, SQLAlchemy Session typing, and use privacy/gear utilities when building Activity schema. Also add API docs entry (docs/reference/tcx/tcx.md) and register it in mkdocs.yml. These changes improve readability, modularity and error reporting for TCX file parsing.

subject: Add server settings API reference
message:
Add server settings API reference

Add docs/reference/server_settings.md that exposes backend.app.server_settings for the API reference (python handler, Google-style docstrings). Update mkdocs.yml to include a 'Server settings' entry in the reference navigation.

subject: Fix schema docstrings formatting
message:
Fix schema docstrings formatting

Normalize docstring formatting across several schema files: adjust indentation for the 'records' description in health_sleep, health_steps, and health_weight list response schemas, and remove redundant '(plus all fields inherited ...)' lines from server_settings schema docstrings. Purely cosmetic cleanup; no functional changes.

subject: Add API key support and upload auth
message:
Add API key support and upload auth

Introduce a users_api_keys subsystem and enable API-key-based auth for activity uploads. Changes include: - New users_api_keys package (models, CRUD, schemas, utils, router, __init__) and docs. - Alembic migration added/renamed to create users_api_keys table and related schema changes; env.py imports the new model. - Unified authentication in auth/security.py: AuthContext, validate_api_key, validate_access_token_or_api_key, get_user_id_from_auth, and check_auth_scopes (SHA-256 hashing, constant-time compare, expiry/revocation checks, audit logging, last_used update). - Added activities.api_upload_router and switched the upload endpoint to accept either JWT or API key with the new activities:upload scope. - Updated auth constants to include activities:upload scope and scope description. - Registered new routers in core/routes and added relationship on Users model. - MKDocs navigation updated to include Users API keys docs.

subject: Add users_api_keys tests and test agent configs
message:
Add users_api_keys tests and test agent configs

Add a comprehensive test suite for users_api_keys (CRUD, models, router, schema, utils) under backend/tests/users/users_api_keys and wire the router into tests via backend/tests/conftest.py (include DEFAULT_ROUTER_MODULES and prefix mapping). Rename multiple test directories from singular user_* to users_* for consistency. Add .github agent configs for Test Implementor and Test Reviewer. Minor mkdocs.yml change included.

subject: Add API keys management UI and translations
message:
Add API keys management UI and translations

Introduce API keys management: add two modal components (create + reveal) and an ApiKeyListItemComponent for listing keys. Integrate API key flows into SettingsSecurityZone (load, create, reveal, revoke, delete) and wire up modals and state handling. Add localization strings for API key UI across multiple locales. Also include supporting updates to profileService and serviceUtils to handle API key endpoints.

subject: Add API key authentication docs
message:
Add API key authentication docs

Add comprehensive API Key authentication documentation to the developer guide: overview, security notice, key format, scopes, authentication examples (header and query param), management endpoints (/profile/api_keys), accepted endpoints (e.g. activities upload), security properties, and best-practices for usage and rotation. Also bump @vue/tsconfig to ^0.9.0 in frontend/app/package.json and update package-lock.json to match.

subject: Enforce token type and tidy token manager/docs
message:
Enforce token type and tidy token manager/docs

Require and validate JWT token type across the auth flow and clean up related code/docs. TokenManager.validate_token_expiration now takes an expected TokenType and enforces the "typ" claim; token creation now sets the "typ" claim. Updated all validation call sites to pass TokenType.ACCESS or TokenType.REFRESH. Also renamed bearer_token -> access_token in validate_access_token_or_api_key, fixed some log/message formatting, and applied docstring/whitespace reflow improvements throughout security.py and token_manager.py for readability.

subject: Add rate limits, secure compare, MFA TTL cleanup
message:
Add rate limits, secure compare, MFA TTL cleanup

Replace manual constant-time string comparison with hmac.compare_digest for secure comparisons. Introduce additional rate limit constants and apply limiter decorators to session refresh, logout, password reset (request/confirm) and sign-up confirm endpoints; add Request parameters to those handlers. Enhance PendingMFALogin with TTLed entries, timestamps, lazy eviction on access, an explicit cleanup_expired() method and a top-level cleanup_expired_pending_mfa_logins helper; register that cleanup as a scheduled job. Misc: update imports, docstrings, typing and add informational logging when expired MFA entries are removed.

subject: Use HMAC-SHA256 for CSRF token handling
message:
Use HMAC-SHA256 for CSRF token handling

Replace slow password hashing for CSRF tokens with HMAC-SHA256.

- auth/router.py: switch CSRF validation to users_sessions_utils.verify_csrf_token instead of password_hasher.verify.
- users/users_sessions/utils.py: add hashlib and hmac imports, implement _hash_csrf_token() and verify_csrf_token() that compute/verify an HMAC-SHA256 using auth_constants.JWT_SECRET_KEY and hmac.compare_digest for constant-time comparison.
- create_session and edit_session now store the HMAC of the CSRF token instead of a password hash.

This change improves performance (HMAC is microseconds-fast) and ensures MAC-based unforgeability while using constant-time comparison to mitigate timing attacks.

subject: Restrict refresh-token cookie path to /api/v1/auth
message:
Restrict refresh-token cookie path to /api/v1/auth

Change the path for the refresh-token cookie from "/" to "/api/v1/auth" in three places (exchange_tokens_for_session in identity_providers/public_router.py, refresh_token in router.py, and complete_login in utils.py). This scopes the refresh token cookie to the auth API endpoints only, reducing exposure to unrelated routes while keeping existing expiry, secure, and samesite settings.

subject: Honor TRUSTED_PROXIES for client IPs
message:
Honor TRUSTED_PROXIES for client IPs

Add TRUSTED_PROXIES config and enforce it when extracting client IPs. Implement _is_trusted_peer (supports exact IPs, CIDR ranges, and the special "*" wildcard) and update get_ip_address to only trust X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP when the direct TCP peer is a trusted proxy, preventing header spoofing. Import ipaddress and core.config where needed, and document the new TRUSTED_PROXIES env var in the getting-started guide. Returns the raw socket IP or "unknown" when peers are untrusted or absent.

subject: Log trusted proxies on startup
message:
Log trusted proxies on startup

Print the configured TRUSTED_PROXIES to the log and console during application startup using core_logger.print_to_log_and_console. This provides visibility into the trusted proxy configuration (core_config.TRUSTED_PROXIES) for debugging and operational checks; the call is added in startup_event after allowed_tile_domains initialization.

subject: Refactor password_reset_tokens module
message:
Refactor password_reset_tokens module

Add module exports, docs, and modernize password_reset_tokens implementation. Introduces .github agent for module audit orchestration and API reference doc + mkdocs nav update. Refactors models to SQLAlchemy 2 style (Mapped, mapped_column, relationship), updates CRUD to use SQLAlchemy core/select/delete and a DB error decorator, adds db.refresh where needed, and returns proper types. Schemas migrated to stricter Pydantic usage (Strict types, Field, ConfigDict) and new PasswordResetResponse schema. Router endpoints now declare response_model and status_code and return typed Pydantic responses. Utilities and email builders receive clearer typing and simplified/cleaned logic and docstrings. Intention is purely code-quality modernization (type hints, patterns, docs) with no business-logic changes; small TODO left in models for future mapping improvements.

subject: Add shared email templates and refactor emails
message:
Add shared email templates and refactor emails

Introduce core.email_templates with shared html_header/html_footer, brand link colour constants, and logo URL. Refactor password-reset and sign-up email builders to use the shared templates, centralised link colours, and html-escape user-provided text. Add/adjust imports, tighten return type hints to tuple[str,str,str], improve admin sign-off text, and sanitize usernames used in URLs. Overall this removes duplicated HTML and standardises footer/link styling across email messages.

subject: Refactor sign-up & password reset token modules
message:
Refactor sign-up & password reset token modules

Large refactor across sign_up_tokens and password_reset_tokens: add/clean up docstrings and type hints, replace legacy SQLAlchemy ORM queries with select/execute and mapped_column usage, and normalize boolean checks (.is_(False)). Introduce core.decorators.handle_db_errors on CRUD functions, simplify commit/refresh flows, and return row counts for bulk deletes. Improve Pydantic schemas (strict types, SignUpResponse), add response_model to router endpoints, and return structured SignUpResponse objects. Enhance email message and utility functions with clearer docs, error handling, and consistent argument formatting. Misc: small comment/format fixes and logging message improvements.

subject: Refactor notifications module and add docs
message:
Refactor notifications module and add docs

Major refactor of the notifications package: convert constants to an IntEnum, modernize the SQLAlchemy models to use Mapped/mapped_column and typing, and rewrite Pydantic schemas into NotificationBase, NotificationCreate and NotificationRead (with created_at serializer). CRUD was rewritten to use SQLAlchemy select(), return model instances, add get_user_notifications_count and paginated queries, and wrapped handlers with a DB error decorator. Utilities were consolidated around an async _create_and_notify helper that creates notifications and pushes websocket messages; websocket notification flows updated accordingly. Router signatures and response models/status codes were tightened and dependency validation signatures adjusted. Added API reference docs for notifications and sign_up_tokens and updated mkdocs navigation.

subject: Add notifications scopes and secure endpoints
message:
Add notifications scopes and secure endpoints

Introduce NOTIFICATIONS_REGULAR_SCOPE and add notifications:read/write to SCOPE_DICT and REGULAR_ACCESS_SCOPE so notification permissions are defined. Update notifications router to import FastAPI Security and apply auth_security.check_scopes dependencies on endpoints (read vs write) to enforce scope checks. Also remove an unused Security import from auth/security.py and add brief dependency parameter docs.

subject: Fix cookie path, remove debug, update router guard
message:
Fix cookie path, remove debug, update router guard

Backend: use the API auth path when deleting the refresh cookie (change path from "/" to "/api/v1/auth") and correct a comment in core/dependencies to reference the `min` parameter. Frontend: remove a leftover console.log from the Health dashboard and refactor the router.beforeEach guard to use return-based navigation (returning route objects) instead of the next() callback, ensuring proper redirect to login/home with query preservation.

subject: Add SE API reviewer agent and fix status code
message:
Add SE API reviewer agent and fix status code

Add a new read-only API reviewer agent spec at .github/agents/se-api-reviewer.agent.md to guide module-specific FastAPI reviews (REST design, schemas, auth, error handling, etc.).

Also adjust backend/app/server_settings/router.py: change the PUT / (edit_server_settings) response status from 201 Created to 200 OK to reflect that the endpoint updates an existing resource (response_model remains ServerSettingsRead). This aligns the HTTP status with the operation semantics.

subject: Refactor migrations module and handlers
message:
Refactor migrations module and handlers

Refactored migrations module: add package exports (__init__), docs entry and mkdocs navigation. Refactor CRUD to use SQLAlchemy select, type hints and a DB-error decorator; add get_migrations_not_executed and set_migration_as_executed signatures and stable error handling. Rework migration scripts (migration_1..6) with docstrings, stronger typing, safer stream/file handling, improved logging and fewer assumptions when streams/files are missing. Convert Migration model to SQLAlchemy typed Mapped/mapped_column usage and expand schema StreamType docs. Add utils orchestration to map and run sync/async migrations in order. Overall improves type safety, error handling, readability and documents the migrations API.

subject: Add fasting end/status; fix sleep inputs
message:
Add fasting end/status; fix sleep inputs

Add optional end time and status fields to the fasting add/edit modal (template, refs, initialization and emit). Compute and emit actual_duration_seconds when end time is provided, include fast_end_time, status and preserve source on edit. Add i18n labels for the new fields. In the sleep modal, guard datetime formatting for null values and default form inputs to empty strings. Also tidy logger docstrings and type hints (Optional Exception) and minor comment/text updates.

subject: Add per-sport activity stats API & UI
message:
Add per-sport activity stats API & UI

Replace simple weekly/monthly distance endpoints with richer per-sport stats (distance, time, calories). #135

Backend: introduce ActivitySportStats and ActivityStats schemas, add calculate_activity_stats() to aggregate distance/time/calories, update router endpoints from /thisweek/distances and /thismonth/distances to /thisweek/stats and /thismonth/stats (response models updated), and adjust token_user_id typing and return empty stats when no activities.

Frontend: update activitiesService to call new endpoints; refactor UserDistanceStatsComponent to accept stats props, add metric toggle (distance/time/calories), formatting helpers, sport definitions and top-3 selection based on selected metric; update i18n files with new toggle labels; update HomeView and UserView to use new prop/state names (thisWeekStats/thisMonthStats). Minor logging/error handling added in utils.

subject: Add activity map thumbnail support #380
message:
Add activity map thumbnail support #380

Generate, store and serve static map thumbnails for activities. Adds a new thumbnail generator (staticmap-based) that renders route polylines and start/end markers and saves PNGs to ACTIVITY_THUMBNAILS_DIR. Introduces a map_thumbnail_path column on the activities model (and alembic migration), a CRUD helper to set the thumbnail path, and calls to generate and persist thumbnails during activity import. The app now mounts the thumbnails directory as static files and exposes a core route to return thumbnails; the activity delete flow will also attempt to remove generated thumbnails. Adds ACTIVITY_THUMBNAILS_DIR to configuration and .gitignore entries for thumbnail images. Also includes related utility and schema updates, and updates to dependency files (poetry.lock/pyproject) and frontend types/components to accommodate thumbnails.

subject: Update login image and add versioned assets
message:
Update login image and add versioned assets

Replace the existing frontend/app/src/assets/login.png with an updated image, and add two versioned copies: login_v_0_16_0.png and login_v_0_17_0.png. These new assets preserve historical login UI screenshots for v0.16.0 and v0.17.0 while the primary login.png is updated.

subject: Generate missing activity map thumbnails #380
message:
Generate missing activity map thumbnails #380

Add automated generation of missing map thumbnails for activities. Changes include:

- activities/activity/crud.py: add get_activities_without_thumbnail(db) to return activities with map_thumbnail_path = NULL and log errors.
- activities/activity/utils.py: implement generate_missing_activity_thumbnails() which opens its own DB session, fetches activities without thumbnails, loads GPS stream data, generates thumbnails, persists thumbnail paths, and logs progress/errors per activity.
- core/scheduler.py: register the thumbnail generator as a scheduled job (interval, 60 minutes).
- main.py: trigger a one-time run of the generator at startup.

The implementation skips activities without GPS streams, decrypts tileserver API key when present, uses server settings fallbacks, and continues on per-activity errors while reporting counts.

subject: Handle API key for Stadia and other map URLs
message:
Handle API key for Stadia and other map URLs

Only inject the `Authorization` header when the URL is for stadiamaps.com; for other map providers, append the `api_key` as a query parameter (using `?` or `&` as appropriate). This ensures Stadia Maps receives backend auth while other services get the key via URL params.

subject: Regenerate thumbnails on tileserver changes #380
message:
Regenerate thumbnails on tileserver changes #380

Add support to delete and regenerate activity thumbnails when tile server settings change. Database migration adds a tileserver_regenerate_thumbnails_on_change boolean to server_settings; ORM model and pydantic schema updated. Backend: add clear_all_activity_thumbnail_paths and delete_and_regenerate_all_activity_thumbnails utilities, schedule regeneration as a background task from server settings edit when map-related fields change, and log/skip Stadia Maps thumbnails if no API key. Frontend: expose the new setting in the server settings UI and add i18n text.

subject: Add Strava rate-limit handling and guards #436 #517
message:
Add Strava rate-limit handling and guards #436 #517

Implement robust Strava rate limit handling and defensive API guards. Added StravaRateLimitTracker, is_strava_rate_limit_error helper and a no-op rate limiter in backend/app/strava/utils.py; create_strava_client now disables stravalib rate limiting and injects the no-op limiter. Added checks to skip or fail fast when rate limits are active across activity fetch/parse/streams and scheduled retrievals in backend/app/strava/activity_utils.py, and mark rate limits when detected (short vs long/daily). Wrapped startup token refresh and initial activity retrieval in backend/app/main.py with try/except to avoid crashing startup on Strava errors. Also increased Docker healthcheck start-period and retries in docker/Dockerfile. Misc: improved logging/messages and adjusted stravalib imports and exception handling.

subject: Refactored GPX parser and threadpool parsing
message:
Refactored GPX parser and threadpool parsing

Refactored backend/app/gpx module with a robust parse_gpx_file utility and lap generation helpers. Refactor GPX parsing into helpers (_extract_extension_data, _compute_lap_metrics, filtered waypoint logic, improved stream detection) and improve error handling, timezone resolution, UTF-8 file reading, and normalized power naming. Update activities to run parse_file in a thread pool (fastapi.concurrency.run_in_threadpool + functools.partial) to avoid blocking the event loop. Add API docs entry for GPX and update mkdocs navigation; also rename TCX doc path.

subject: Refactor GPX parsing and add typing
message:
Refactor GPX parsing and add typing

Introduce typed structures and modularize GPX parsing logic. Added TypedDicts (LapMetrics, ParsedGpxData), improved type annotations across helpers, and convert HR/cadence extension values to ints. Split logic into smaller functions (_init_parsing_state, _process_track_metadata, _process_trackpoint, _compute_derived_metrics, _build_activity_schema) and refactored parse_gpx_file to use a shared state object and return ParsedGpxData. Updated generate_activity_laps signature/return typing and exported it from the gpx package (__init__.py). These changes improve readability, testability and type safety while preserving existing behavior and error handling.

subject: Add paginated gears API and client support
message:
Add paginated gears API and client support

Backend: introduce paginated gears support and response model. Added select import and core.decorators usage, implemented get_gears_number (count) and refactored get_gear_users_with_pagination to use SQLAlchemy select with optional pagination and show_inactive filtering, wrapped DB calls with handle_db_errors, and added GearsListResponse Pydantic model. Router: replaced previous gears endpoints with read_gears_user_all_pagination, wired pagination/filters via Query and core dependency validation, and return GearsListResponse including total, page_number, num_records and records. Frontend: update services and views to consume the new paginated response shape — gears.getUserGearsWithPagination now builds query strings (supports filters and pagination) and components/views updated to read .records and handle loading/finalization; minor usersService default param tweak and small UI fixes in Settings components.

subject: Reformat GPX docstrings and error messages
message:
Reformat GPX docstrings and error messages

Reflow and rewrap docstrings and inline error message strings in backend/app/gpx/__init__.py and backend/app/gpx/utils.py for improved readability. These changes only adjust formatting and line breaks; no functional logic was modified.

subject: Refactor gears module, models, CRUD and routers
message:
Refactor gears module, models, CRUD and routers

Introduce a proper gears package and comprehensive refactor of the gear submodule: modernize the ORM model to use mapped_column/SQLAlchemy typing and add docstrings; rewrite CRUD to use select/delete statements, a DB error handler decorator, and improved transaction/error handling (including IntegrityError handling and clearer HTTP errors); overhaul create_multiple_gears/create_gear logic to validate, deduplicate, skip existing gears and persist safely; update dependency validators signatures and add clearer validation behavior; enhance API router endpoints with explicit response models, status codes, dependency annotations and docs; and adjust related type hints in garmin/strava utilities. These changes improve type-safety, clarity, and robustness of DB operations and HTTP responses, but include signature/return-type changes that may require updates where these functions are used.

subject: Refactor health cards into reusable component
message:
Refactor health cards into reusable component

Add HealthDashboardCardComponent.vue to encapsulate a health metric card (loading placeholder, main value/no-data fallback, optional subtitle, simple footer or target footer with arrow). Replace duplicated card markup in HealthDashboardZoneComponent.vue with multiple instances of the new component and move display/formatting logic into computed properties (value formatting, target display values, arrow directions, subtitles). Import the new component and services, reducing duplication and centralizing presentation/logic for sleep, resting HR, skin temp, weight, BMI, steps, and fasting cards.

subject: Add loading placeholders to health zones
message:
Add loading placeholders to health zones

Introduce reusable placeholder components (BarChart, LineChart, List, StatsCards) to provide skeleton UIs while data loads. Integrate these placeholders into HealthFastingZone, HealthRHRZone, HealthSleepZone, HealthStepsZone and HealthWeightZone: replace previous LoadingComponent usage, add placeholder-glow elements, prevent rendering of active cards/graphs while loading, and disable filter/pagination selects during loading. These changes improve perceived performance and provide consistent loading states across health views.

subject: Edit gear using body id; improve UI loading/filters
message:
Edit gear using body id; improve UI loading/filters

Back-end: Change edit flow to use GearUpdate (includes id) instead of a path param. Router PUT no longer takes gear_id or validate dependency and uses gear.id for lookups; crud.edit_gear and error messages updated accordingly. Schema: GearUpdate now defines an id: StrictInt field.

Front-end: gearsService.editGear now sends the full data payload (PUT to 'gears') and callers updated (GearsAddEditGearModalComponent). Fixed select option bindings to use :value. GearsView: streamline loading state (removed isGearsUpdatingLoading), add placeholders (ListWithIconPlaceholderComponent), add filter dropdown and showInactive option (i18n key added), adjust loading handling and watches, and update imports.

subject: Add health_poop and health_water features
